title: HR Coordinator (remote)
description:
We are looking for a People & Culture / HR Coordinator to help us build a strong, positive company culture and make sure our team feels supported, motivated, and aligned with the company’s vision.



This role is not just about hiring people.



We want someone who understands the CEO’s vision, believes in where the company is going, and can help communicate that vision clearly to the rest of the team so everyone feels like they are working toward the same goal.



You will also help us find great people, support existing team members, identify problems early, and make the company a genuinely good place to work.



WHAT YOU WILL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR

Recruitment & Hiring

Post job advertisements

Source and find strong candidates

Review applications

Conduct initial interviews and screening

Coordinate interviews with management

Follow up with candidates throughout the hiring process

Help onboard new employees

Maintain an organized hiring pipeline

Help management continuously find better people as the company grows

Employee Wellbeing

Regularly check in with team members

Understand how employees are feeling about their work

Identify signs of burnout, frustration, low motivation, or other problems

Make sure team members feel heard and supported

Help resolve smaller people-related problems before they become bigger issues

Escalate serious concerns to the management team quickly

Help management understand what is happening inside the team



You are not expected to act as a therapist, but you should care about people and be comfortable noticing when someone is struggling or unhappy.



Company Culture

Help build a positive and enjoyable company culture

Make sure employees understand the company’s mission, values, and direction

Help communicate messages from the CEO and management to the wider team

Come up with simple ideas to keep the team connected and motivated

Organize small online team activities

Remember and recognize birthdays and important milestones

Help organize things like online Friday drinks, games, celebrations, or team events

Find simple ways to make people feel appreciated

Help make the company somewhere people are excited to work



We do not want forced corporate activities.



We want someone who can naturally create a good environment where people feel connected to the company and to each other.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



We are looking for someone who is:



Very good with people

Friendly and approachable

Emotionally intelligent

Organized

Reliable

Comfortable speaking with different personalities

Good at noticing when something is wrong

Comfortable having difficult conversations when necessary

Able to communicate management’s vision clearly

Proactive rather than waiting for instructions

Good at following up with people

Comfortable recruiting and interviewing candidates

Able to keep confidential information private

Able to work independently

Positive and energetic without being fake or overly corporate



Previous HR, recruitment, team management, employee engagement, or people operations experience is preferred.



THIS ROLE MAY BE A GOOD FIT IF



You naturally enjoy:



Talking to people

Helping people solve problems

Finding good candidates

Building relationships

Making people feel included

Organizing activities

Improving the work environment

Understanding why someone might be unhappy or underperforming

Helping a team feel connected to a bigger mission

THIS ROLE WILL NOT SUIT SOMEONE WHO

Only wants to post job ads and process paperwork

Is uncomfortable talking to employees about problems

Avoids difficult conversations

Does not follow up

Waits for management to notice every problem first

Is not interested in company culture

Struggles to keep confidential information private

Does not genuinely care about how employees are doing



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



After a few months:



Hiring is organized and candidates move through the process quickly

Management always knows the status of open positions

New employees have a smooth onboarding experience

Employees feel comfortable speaking to you when something is wrong

Burnout or team problems are noticed earlier

Important employee concerns reach management quickly

The team understands the company’s vision and goals

Employees feel recognized and appreciated

Small culture activities happen consistently

The company feels more connected as it grows



The main goal of this role is simple:



Help us find great people, keep great people, and build a company that people genuinely enjoy being part of.



Please fill out this Google form to be considered.

title: Full-Time WFH Client Success Manager — $2,000 Base + Bonuses
description:
JOB OVERVIEW



Full-Time | Monday-Friday | PH Morning / US Evening Coverage



We are hiring Philippines-based Client Success Managers to support U.S. clients during evening hours, especially Pacific Time.



This is a client leadership role, not just support.



You will own the client relationship, keep clients clear and accountable, create momentum, prevent frustration, and escalate risks early.



This role is best for someone with excellent English, strong emotional intelligence, high ownership, and confidence handling high-ticket clients calmly.



Success is measured by retention, trust, communication, accountability, client momentum, and risk prevention.



SALARY



- Ramp / Trial CSM: USD 1,500/month base

- Certified CSM: USD 2,000/month base

- OTE: USD 2,500-3,000+/month with performance bonuses

- Paid twice a month via Wise

- Certification is performance-based, usually reviewed after 30-60 days, and requires consistent performance, quality-control review, and leadership approval



SCHEDULE



- Monday-Friday

- Full-time: 7.5 hours a day; 37.5 hours/week

- Core client coverage: 6 AM-12 PM PH time

- Split shifts are allowed

- Afternoons and early evenings are generally free

- Required team/training meetings may happen around 9 PM-11 PM PH time

- Occasional client calls may run up to 12 PM PH time when needed

- Final schedule will be agreed during hiring and must be sustainable long-term



ABOUT US



We help creators, beginners, coaches, and business owners grow and monetize online using short-form content, AI tools, strategy, coaching, and accountability.



We provide an “80% done-for-you” content and monetization system that helps clients turn short-form content into audience growth, leads, and income.



We have worked with 4,000+ clients since 2019.



Most clients are U.S.-based, and many are age 45+, so patience, clarity, emotional intelligence, and professional English communication are very important.



RESPONSIBILITIES



- Run client kickoff calls using our onboarding framework

- Set clear expectations from day one

- Help clients understand what to do next and why it matters

- Keep clients accountable to action items and deadlines

- Follow up with stuck, quiet, inactive, or delayed clients

- Re-engage clients before momentum is lost

- Respond to client messages within 24 weekday hours

- Close loops and avoid dangling threads

- Handle difficult conversations calmly and professionally

- De-escalate frustrated or emotional clients

- Identify refund, payment, chargeback, cancellation, and satisfaction risks early

- Escalate issues quickly according to SOPs

- Keep clear notes in Airtable / CRM

- Coordinate internally when support or escalation is needed

- Support renewals, referrals, testimonials, and upsell opportunities when appropriate

- Join required trainings, daily team Zoom calls, and feedback sessions

- Once activated, host a weekly client-support call or own a similar client-success responsibility



CLIENT LOAD



You will ramp gradually.



The target for a Certified CSM is 40-50 active clients, depending on client complexity, program type, and client inflow.



When fewer clients are available, CSMs may support reactivation, offboarding, client check-ins, and legacy-client cleanup.



BENEFITS



- Fully remote role

- Payment: Twice a month via Wise, always on time

- Performance-based bonuses

- Clear path from Ramp / Trial CSM to Certified CSM

- Growth opportunity into leadership

- Supportive international team

- Daily trainings and team Zoom calls

- SOPs, support, and structure provided

- Work with creators, brands, short-form content, and AI tools

- Required tools paid for after the test month where applicable

- Afternoons and early evenings generally free, with required evening meetings



REQUIREMENTS



- Currently based in the Philippines

- Fluent, professional English

- Clear and easily understood verbal communication

- Strong communication and emotional intelligence

- Calm under pressure

- High ownership, follow-through, and reliability

- Strong say-do ratio and respect for deadlines

- Comfortable handling difficult, emotional, or high-ticket clients

- Comfortable with uncomfortable conversations

- Strong Airtable / CRM documentation habits

- Reliable internet connection and professional home setup

- Willing to use Hubstaff during working hours

- Able to work PH morning / U.S. evening hours

- Comfortable with split shifts and required evening meetings

- Able to manage up to 40-50 active clients once trained and certified

- Able to meet certification standards without heavy supervision

- Able to identify and escalate refund, payment, chargeback, cancellation, and client-satisfaction risks quickly



NICE TO HAVE EXPERIENCE



- Client Success

- Account Management

- Coaching

- High-ticket programs

- Online education

- Social media monetization

- Content strategy

- Creator economy

- AI tools like ChatGPT, CapCut, or Submagic

- Working with U.S. clients



WE’RE THE RIGHT FIT IF



You’ll likely thrive here if you:



- Enjoy client-facing communication

- Stay calm when clients are emotional, frustrated, or confused

- Take ownership without needing to be micromanaged

- Follow through consistently and stay organized

- Want a long-term role with growth potential

- Can balance empathy with accountability

- Are comfortable working with U.S.-based clients



HOW TO APPLY



Apply here:



IMPORTANT: Put “CSM” + Your Full Name in the Name field.



P.S. Once hired, you will be contracted under Social Influence Consulting LLC.

title: CLIENT SUCCESS MANAGER – $2,000 P/M + UNCAPPED COMMISSION
description:
Full-Time | Long-Term Role



SALARY



- $1,500 per month during Ramp / Trial period. Upon certification (typically 30–60 days), base increases to $2,000.

- On-Target Earnings are $2,500, including a $500 performance bonus (capped).

- Commission on renewals and upsells is uncapped and paid in addition to base and bonus.

- Additional performance-based incentives may apply.



Payment: Twice a month via Wise. Always on time.



This is a long-term leadership role. You are not here to answer questions. You are here to ensure clients stay, progress, and succeed. You own retention, stability, and client momentum.



Client retention outcomes are directly linked to your performance reviews and income growth.



ABOUT US



Young Publisher – 



We are an international digital marketing company serving 4,000+ clients since 2019.



We sell an “80% done-for-you” content and monetization system helping creators go viral and generate income using short-form content and AI tools.



Most clients are 45+ beginners. They are motivated but often overwhelmed. They need clarity, structure, accountability, and calm leadership.



SCHEDULE



- Full-time, 7.5 hours per day, Monday to Friday.

- You can work your hours in one block or split them, as long as you consistently meet the job requirements.

- You will serve clients during your assigned 7.5-hour shift within our main coverage window (8am ET–2am ET)

- Must attend team meetings (usually 3pm CET).



RESPONSIBILITIES



- Manage 40–50 clients after ramp-up (with systems and internal support in place).

- Run structured kickoff calls.

- Set clear expectations from day one.

- Own the client relationship end-to-end.

- Prevent churn and refund requests.

- Identify frustration early and de-escalate calmly.

- Handle difficult conversations professionally.

- Hold clients accountable to next steps.

- Follow up when clients go quiet.

- Ensure clients always know what to do next and why it matters.

- Respond within 24 hours (weekdays).

- Track progress clearly in CRM.

- Lead renewal conversations.

- Identify upsell opportunities when appropriate.

- Collect testimonials and referrals.

- Clients should never feel lost. You are responsible for clarity and momentum.



Preventable churn caused by communication gaps, missed follow-ups, or expectation mismanagement reflects on CSM performance. You are not responsible for factors outside your control.



HOW YOU WIN



- Clients stay in the program.

- Renewals remain strong.

- Refunds are rare.

- Clients feel clear and stable.

- Difficult situations are handled calmly.



REQUIREMENTS



- Near-native spoken English with very clear pronunciation for U.S.-based clients.

- Confident on Zoom.

- Strong emotional intelligence.

- Calm under pressure.

- High ownership and follow-through.

- Comfortable with uncomfortable conversations.

- Proactive and organized.

- Reliable internet and professional home setup.

- Strong say-do ratio and respect for deadlines.



NICE TO HAVE EXPERIENCE



- Client Success or Account Management

- High-ticket program

- Knowledge of social media monetization.

- Familiarity with AI tools (ChatGPT, CapCut, etc.).



HOW TO APPLY



Apply here: 
/to/Su5De9Qc



IMPORTANT: Put “CSM” + Your Full Name in the Name field.



P.S. Once hired, you will be contracted under Social Influence Consulting LLC.

title: Fulltime Video Editor | Longterm Position
description:
We are looking for a full-time video editor with a strong focus on talking-head content and experience with storytelling.



We are a fast growing media company, we produce content for clients across multiple niches. You'll primarily be cutting talking-head videos, with short-form editing experience being a strong plus. If you are experienced in turning raw footage into something people actually want to watch, keep reading.



What you'll be doing



- Editing talking-head and vlog-style videos from raw footage to final delivery

- Plus point if you are comfortable working with Davinci Resolve, Premiere Pro, After Effects

- Shaping pacing, structure, and flow so every edit tells a story, not just cuts clips together

- Handling a variety of edit styles depending on the client and the brief, with short-form editing being a bonus

- Managing your own time across multiple projects and hitting deadlines without being chased



What we're looking for



- Strong proficiency in video editing, with a focus on talking-head content

- A fully dedicated editor who isn't juggling other clients or companies on the side

- Good written and spoken English for clear communication

- Strong time management and the ability to juggle multiple edits

- Short-form editing experience is a plus

- Hungry to grow, take feedback, and get better with every project (massive growth opportunities)



Available full-time during fixed hours: 8:30–17:00 (Philippine Timezone)



Required to apply



Please include a link to your portfolio, applications without sample work won't be considered.



Also, start your message with the word "BANANA" so we know you've actually read the job description.

title: Full-Time WFH Technical Onboarding Specialist — $900 Base + Bonuses
description:
We are hiring a Technical Onboarding Manager (TOM).



Your job is to guide new clients through their first 48 hours inside the program. You remove confusion, fix tech issues, assign the right 1:1 Coach, and make sure clients are fully set up before strategy begins.



This is not a passive support role. You are responsible for structure, clarity, activation speed, and client confidence.



This is a client-facing role. You must be clear, confident, calm, and reliable.



Most of our clients are 45+ and not tech-savvy. Patience and strong communication are required.



BENEFITS



- Salary: $900 per month

- Payment: Twice a month via Wise. Always on time.

- Performance bonuses based on CSAT (client rating) and CSQ (coach rating)

- OTE: $1,050–$1,400/month

- Bonus tiers from $30–$100 per category (minimum 20 surveys / 20 handoffs per month)

- Fully remote, long-term role

- Clear scorecard and monthly reviews

- Career growth path (Senior TOM, Lead TOM, CSM)

- 4,000+ clients served since 2019



SCHEDULE



- Full-time: 7.5 hours a day; 37.5 hours/week

- No fixed shift required. You may work a straight or split shift.

- You must attend team meetings (usually 3pm CET)

- Work 7.5 total hours per day within the 8 AM ET to 2 AM ET coverage window, not across the entire window

- Confirm your preferred working hours during hiring

- Maintain a schedule that is sustainable long term



Consistently low energy or repeated mistakes caused by poor schedule management will be treated as performance issues.



RESPONSIBILITIES



- Run structured Activation Calls

- Fully activate every client within 48 hours. Activation means the client has access to Kajabi, Slack, the Client Master Sheet, AI tools (AVA & VERA), understands where everything is, has a Coach assigned, and has their Kickoff Call booked.

- Book Kickoff Call same day or next day

- Assign the correct 1:1 Coach based on phase, fluency, timezone, and availability

- Build authority for the assigned Coach so the client feels confident before strategy begins

- Ensure basic access or setup issues do not reach Coaches

- Update CRM immediately after each call

- Send clear handoff notes to Coaches

- Upload all call recordings

- Reply in #tech-support within 24 hours (weekdays)

- Onboard 20–25 clients per week. Activation Calls are structured and typically 30–45 minutes.

Some weeks are high-volume during promotions. Quality and clarity must remain strong under pressure.

- Keep your calendar accurate and available

- Proactively manage your calendar capacity and flag issues early

- Avoid repeated client-facing process errors



Main goal: Zero confusion for the client. No surprises for the Coach.



CORE STANDARDS



- 100% activation within 48 hours

- CSAT average 85%+

- No Kickoff Call no-shows

- Prevent basic technical escalations

- High CRM accuracy and immediate handoffs

- 24-hour Slack response time

- Reliable, consistent performance



REQUIREMENTS



- Strong customer support or onboarding experience

- C1 English or higher

- Calm with older or low-tech clients

- Comfortable repeating instructions clearly multiple times

- Follows SOPs and scripts closely

- Advanced Slack skills

- Comfortable with Kajabi, Google Drive, and Zoom

- Willing to learn basic creator tools

- Reliable internet, strong camera, proper lighting, and quiet workspace

- Strong schedule discipline



WE ARE NOT A FIT IF



- You are low energy or unclear

- You get frustrated with confused clients

- You cannot explain tech in simple words

- You struggle to follow structured processes

- You cannot consistently maintain agreed working hours

- You have poor camera, lighting, or internet setup



HOW TO APPLY



Fill in the form: 
/to/nI8lIXV4



In the Name field, write: “TOM” + Your First and Last Name



Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.



P.S. Once hired, you will be contracted under Social Influence Consulting LLC.

title: AI VIDEO CREATOR & EDITOR — FULL-TIME
description:
AI VIDEO CREATOR & EDITOR — FULL-TIME



Read this first: this is not a general video-editing job.



You must already have hands-on experience creating video footage with AI tools. If you have never personally generated an AI video shot, this role is not for you.



ABOUT THE ROLE



We are a new European jewelry brand launching soon. Video will be one of the main ways we reach customers—and you will be responsible for creating it.



I provide the brief: the concept, marketing angle, product information, and references. You turn it into a finished short-form video.



You will work across multiple styles, including:



* AI UGC: realistic people talking about or using the product

* Product-focused videos

* ASMR content

* Cartoon and animated videos

* Paid social advertisements

* Organic short-form content

* New formats and creative styles we have not tested yet



AI generation is the most important part of this role.



Editing can be learned. What is harder to find is someone who knows how to get a specific shot from an AI tool: choosing the right model, writing strong prompts, using references properly, troubleshooting bad generations, and regenerating until the result is genuinely good—not simply “close enough.”



You will receive access to our paid Higgsfield account. You will never be expected to pay for tools or credits yourself.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



* Generate AI video shots, mainly using Higgsfield

* Turn written briefs into complete short-form videos

* Build strong hooks, pacing, structure, and endings

* Edit videos in CapCut

* Create and synchronize voice-overs using ElevenLabs

* Add readable, correctly timed text overlays

* Select and edit music and sound effects

* Export the correct formats and aspect ratios for organic social content and paid ads

* Iterate based on feedback and performance data

* Keep project files, generations, and final exports organized

* Study which videos perform and use those insights to improve future work

* Proactively suggest new hooks, concepts, and creative directions



MUST HAVE



* Provable experience generating video footage with AI

* Experience with Higgsfield is preferred, but Veo, Sora, Kling, Runway, Hailuo, or similar tools also count

* Strong CapCut skills—editing should not be your bottleneck

* Experience with ElevenLabs or another AI voice platform

* A portfolio containing short-form videos you personally created

* A good understanding of what makes someone stop scrolling within the first two seconds

* Good written English

* The ability to follow and interpret a written brief

* Fast and reliable communication

* Reliable internet and a computer capable of handling video work



NICE TO HAVE



* Experience with jewelry, fashion, beauty, or skincare

* Experience creating Meta or TikTok ad creatives

* AI image-generation experience using tools such as Nano Banana, Midjourney, or Flux

* After Effects experience

* A strong sense of music and sound design

* Experience analyzing creative performance data



HOURS



This is a full-time, long-term role.



The minimum commitment is 40 hours per week. If you can consistently work 50 hours, that is also possible, and every approved hour will be paid.



I am looking for one person who wants to focus seriously on one brand—not someone balancing five clients at the same time.



COMPENSATION — CHOOSE ONE OF TWO OPTIONS



You may choose the compensation model that suits you best.



OPTION 1: HIGHER GUARANTEED HOURLY RATE



* $5 per hour

* Approximately $867 per month at 40 hours per week

* Approximately $1,083 per month at 50 hours per week

* No sales or performance bonuses



This option is for someone who prefers a higher, predictable hourly income.



OPTION 2: LOWER BASE RATE + PERFORMANCE BONUSES



* $3 per hour

* Approximately $520 per month at 40 hours per week

* Approximately $650 per month at 50 hours per week



On top of this base rate, you earn bonuses based on the results of each original video you create:



* 10 sales: $25 bonus

* 25 sales: additional $70 bonus

* 100+ sales within 30 days: additional $250 bonus

* 50,000+ organic views: additional $25 bonus



The sales milestones stack.



Examples:



* 10 sales = $25

* 30 sales = $25 + $70 = $95

* 100+ sales within 30 days = $25 + $70 + $250 = $345

* If the video also reaches 50,000 organic views, the total becomes $370



There is no cap on how many of your videos can earn bonuses.



One strong-performing video can pay more in bonuses than an entire month of hourly work. This option is for someone willing to accept a lower guaranteed base rate in exchange for significantly more upside.



HOW PERFORMANCE IS MEASURED



To avoid disagreements:



* Sales are measured inside Meta Ads Manager and attributed per creative

* You will be able to see the relevant performance numbers, including sales, spend, and views

* A simple re-edit, resize, or minor variation of an existing video does not count as a completely new video

* A substantially new concept, hook, structure, or creative execution may count as a new video

* Sales bonuses are calculated within the first 30 days after a video starts running



We are a new brand without historical performance data. The bonus framework above is our starting model.



Once we have enough real data, we may discuss adjusting the benchmarks or introducing a combination of sales, creative output, and other performance targets. Any meaningful change will be discussed openly—it will not be changed unexpectedly.



Whichever compensation option you choose, approved working hours are always paid.



WHO THIS ROLE IS FOR



This role is for someone who thinks like an owner.



You should want to understand what each video is supposed to achieve—not just complete the brief.



The right person watches the results, notices which hook or visual worked, learns from failed creatives, and returns with a stronger idea before being asked.



If you only want to clock in, execute instructions exactly, and clock out, this is probably not the right role.



If you need a high guaranteed income immediately, Option 2 is not suitable for you. Choose Option 1 instead.



HOW TO APPLY



Applications without a portfolio will not be considered.



Put the word GOLDFISH at the top of your application so I know you have read the full job post.



Please send:



1. Your portfolio



Include links to short-form videos you personally worked on. Explain exactly what your role was for each video.



2. Proof of your AI video work



Send two or three examples where you personally generated the footage.



For each example, explain:



* Which AI tool you used

* What you generated

* Your prompting and iteration process

* What you did when the output was wrong



Showing a raw AI generation next to the finished edit is strongly preferred.



3. Your tools and experience



List the tools you use and approximately how long you have used each one.



4. Your availability



State how many hours per week you can consistently commit.



5. Your compensation choice



Confirm that you have read both compensation models and choose one:



* Option 1: $5 per hour without performance bonuses

* Option 2: $3 per hour plus performance bonuses



6. Answer these questions



* What is the most recent video you made that you are proud of, and why?

* When an AI video tool repeatedly gives you the wrong shot, what do you actually do?

* Have you ever created a video that measurably generated sales or leads? What were the results?

* Do you have experience with jewelry, fashion, beauty, or a similar visual industry?

* Why do you prefer your chosen compensation model?



HIRING PROCESS



1. Portfolio and application review

2. One short unpaid skills test: a single AI-generated shot requiring approximately 30 minutes

3. One paid trial project at your chosen hourly rate

4. Ongoing full-time role



I reply to everyone who carefully follows the application instructions.

title: Full-Time 2D Animator
description:
I’m looking for a full-time 2D animator to create opening music video–style animations for Mobamon, inspired by early 90s/2000s Japanese anime such as Medabots. The core project is a ~1 minute animated opening sequence with characters, action shots, logo moments, and camera moves that feel like a classic TV opening.







Your main responsibilities will include:



1. Designing and animating characters, creatures, and simple environments in a 90s anime style (bold outlines, clear shapes, expressive poses).



2. Creating storyboards/animatics from a rough script and music track to plan the full opening sequence (beats, camera moves, transitions).



3. Producing traditional frame‑by‑frame or layered digital animation (keys + in‑betweens) for action cuts, character introductions, logo reveals, and montage scenes.



4. Handling digital drawing, clean‑up, and colouring for all shots, keeping line quality and style consistent across the sequence.



5. Syncing animation with music and sound effects (hits on the beat, transitions on key moments, logo on chorus, etc.).



6. Preparing production‑ready files and exports (layered project files + final renders at 1080p or higher), with organised naming and folders so we can reuse assets later.



You should be comfortable drawing digitally and animating your own work, not just rigging or moving pre‑made assets. Strong draftsmanship, character posing, timing, and an understanding of classic anime openings are essential. Tools can vary (Adobe Animate, Toon Boom Harmony, Clip Studio Paint, TVPaint, etc.) as long as you can deliver clean, exportable 2D animation.



Please include in your application:



1. A showreel or links to 2–4 of your best 2D animations, ideally anime‑inspired or character‑driven openings/cutscenes.



2. Samples of your digital character art (full‑body poses, expressions, action shots).



3. A brief description of your animation workflow (from storyboard → keys → in‑betweens → clean‑up → colour → final export).

title: Executive Operations Assistant — Email, Calendar and Nonprofit Administration
description:
Executive Operations Assistant —

Position Overview



I am seeking a reliable, highly organized and proactive **full-time Executive Operations Assistant** to support my work leading a church, nonprofit organization, community programs and a growing leadership brand.

, scheduling, follow-ups, administrative tasks and daily priorities. Additional responsibilities may be added after you demonstrate consistency and strong performance in the core role.



The ideal candidate has excellent written English, strong judgment, attention to detail and previous experience supporting an executive, nonprofit leader, pastor, business owner or organization director.



This is intended to be a long-term position for the right person.

 inbox

s

 communication

s

s, reminders, scheduling issues and unfinished tasks that return to me.

Expected schedule:



**Monday through Friday

8:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m. U.S. Central Time

One-hour unpaid meal break**



You must be comfortable working Philippine overnight hours and have previous experience maintaining a night-shift schedule.



Occasional schedule adjustments may be needed for important events or deadlines. Advance notice will be provided whenever possible.



## Compensation



Starting compensation:



**$6.00–$7.00 USD per hour**, based on experience and demonstrated ability.



Compensation will be paid weekly during the initial probationary period.



The position includes:

* A performance review after 30 days

* A compensation review after 90 days

* Opportunities for increased responsibility and compensation

* Paid time off after successful completion of the probationary period

 inbox

 drafting

Success in this role means:

s are not overlooked

**BEACON 2026**

 inbox you previously managed for an executive or organization.

s, scheduling and task prioritization

title: Customer Service & Store Operations - eCommerce Australia
description:
Let me guess how your week has gone.



You've applied to fifteen jobs. Maybe thirty. Every one of them wanted "a highly motivated self-starter with excellent communication skills". And every single one has left you refreshing your inbox with no idea whether anyone even opened it.



I'm not going to do that to you. Here's exactly what the job is, and exactly what happens next.



I'm Justin. I run a home decor store here in Australia, and I'm looking for someone to help me run it.



Right now I do everything myself. Sourcing, suppliers, orders, the website  and the phone. Something has to give, and lately it's been the phone. It rings, it goes to voi
, customers wait. Sales get missed.



That's the job. You'd be the person who fixes it.





WHY THIS ONE IS DIFFERENT:



We're at the very start of building a proper team, and you'd be one of the first people in it.



That means something real. The way we handle customers, the systems we use, the standards we set - most of that hasn't been d
 yet. You'd help d
 it. The suggestions you make in month two become the way we do things in month six.



It also means room to grow. As we bring more people on, the person who was here first, who knows how everything works, is the person who steps up. I'm not looking for someone to fill a seat for a year. I'm looking for someone who's still here in five, running things.





WHAT YOU'D ACTUALLY DO:



- Pick up the phone. Answer
s and chat. Chase the enquiries that haven't converted yet.

- Process orders in Shopify and keep suppliers moving

- Update stock levels and catch problems before a customer does

- Keep the website up to date - listings, pricing, images, new products

- Get us posting properly on Instagram, Pinterest and Meta, and help build out
 campaigns





WHAT WE NEED:



- Excellent spoken English. You'll be speaking with Australian customers every day, and this is the one we weigh most heavily. 

- Real customer service experience. Real customers, real complaints, real problems solved.

- Clear, warm written English

- A quiet workspace, reliable internet with a backup

- Available Monday to Friday, 6:00am – 2:00pm (Philippine Standard Time)

- Attention to detail 





ABOUT THOSE HOURS:



Because we're Australian, your day runs 6:00am to 2:00pm Manila time. No graveyard shift. No sleeping through the daylight and waking up as everyone else is heading to bed.



You finish in the early afternoon with most of the day still in front of you. Sunshine. The gym. Your kids after school. Dinner with your family, at dinner time. A serious career shouldn't cost you your evenings, and here it doesn't.





NICE TO HAVE (genuinely optional):

Shopify, Canva,
 marketing tools, or experience working in eCommerce. None of these will stop you getting hired. I'd take a brilliant communicator and teach them Shopify over a Shopify expert who can't hold a conversation.





WHAT YOU GET:



- AUD $1,200 per month

- Reviewed every 12 months on performance. Paid leave.

- Actual training - a documented plan and recorded walkthroughs

- A real opportunity to shape how a growing business runs

- Direct access to me. Ask a question, get an answer that day.

- A team that actually enjoys the work. We take the customers seriously and ourselves a lot less so. Expect jokes in the chat, genuine credit when you do something well, and nobody making you feel small for asking a question. 





HOW TO APPLY:



 me directly at 



Use this exact subject line: It's snowing in Sydney



In the body, tell me briefly why you're a good fit and

include a link to your OnlineJobs profile.



I'll reply straight away with the application form.



Applications without that subject line won't be read.





Looking forward to hearing from you!

title: Operations & Scheduling Coordinator
description:
Position Summary 



The VA Scheduler is responsible for coordinating and maintaining client service schedules to support Helping Hands, Orillia's transportation and community support services. The role ensures efficient scheduling of clients, staff, and volunteers using scheduling platforms such as AlayaCare, RideLink and Skedulo, while maintaining a high standard of customer service and operational accuracy. 



The VA Scheduler serves as a key point of coordination between clients, transportation providers, volunteers, frontline staff, and management to ensure services are delivered safely, efficiently, and in accordance with organizational policies and procedures. 



Key Responsibilities 



- Scheduling and Coordination 

- Schedule, modify, and monitor client service appointments and transportation requests. 

- Coordinate transportation bookings, rides, and related client support services. 

- Match client requests with available drivers, staff, and resources. 

- Optimize schedules to maximize operational efficiency and service capacity. 

- Monitor daily schedules and address scheduling conflicts, cancellations, and urgent changes. 

- Ensure service assignments are accurately communicated to staff and volunteers. 



AlayaCare Administration 

- Enter, update, and maintain client scheduling information within AlayaCare. 

- Verify service authorizations, client information, and scheduling requirements. 

- Monitor service delivery documentation and scheduling accuracy. 

- Support staff with scheduling-related inquiries within AlayaCare. 

- Assist with maintaining accurate client records and service data. 



 Skedulo Administration 

- Create, assign, and manage workforce schedules within Skedulo. 

- Monitor visit assignments, routes, and workforce utilization. 

- Update schedules in real time to reflect cancellations, changes, and urgent client needs. 

- Support field staff with schedule access and assignment updates. 

- Generate scheduling reports and operational insights as required. 



Administrative Support 

- Maintain accurate scheduling records and documentation. 

- Prepare operational reports and scheduling metrics as requested. 

- Support quality improvement initiatives related to scheduling and service delivery. 

- Participate in system testing, process improvements, and scheduling optimization projects. 

- Communicate scheduling updates to clients, caregivers, staff, and volunteers. 

- Respond to inquiries regarding appointments, transportation bookings, and service availability. 

- Escalate concerns or service issues to management as appropriate. 



Qualifications 

- Experience in scheduling, dispatching, customer service, or administrative support. 

- Experience in healthcare, community support services, transportation, or a related field is an asset. 

- Familiarity with scheduling and workforce management systems 

- Proficiency with Microsoft 365 applications (Outlook, Teams, Excel, and SharePoint) 

- Experience with AlayaCare, RideLink and Skedulo is considered a strong asset. 

- Strong organizational, multitasking, and time-management skills. 

- Excellent attention to detail and accuracy. 

- Strong customer service, communication, and problem-solving abilities. 

- Ability to work independently in a fast-paced virtual environment.

title: Commission Based Pay - AI Ads for META
description:
Calling AI Performance Creators & Agencies



Performance-Based Commission Pay  where we pay 7.5% of ad spend | Unlimited Upside



At NUTSÓLA we're looking for talented AI creators and creative agencies from around the world to help us develop performance-driven content for our rapidly growing brand.



We currently have two primary sales funnels:



DÄT Chocolate

Complete Protein Powder



We are looking for creative partners who are passionate about storytelling, education, animation, direct-response advertising, and thinking outside the box.



This Is a Performance-Based Opportunity



This is not a traditional flat-fee creative position. Content will be managed through Trybe, where creators/agencies can earn commission based on the sales performance of their videos.



The better your creative performs, the more you can earn—with no fixed cap on your upside.



As NUTSÓLA continues growing into Q4 and beyond, we want our top-performing creators and agencies to grow with us. This opportunity is best suited for partners who are confident in their creative ability and excited about being rewarded for results.



How It Works



Our experienced creative team will:



Provide strategic creative briefs

Share product information and approved messaging

Offer direction based on existing customer and performance insights

Review and approve every video before it is launched

Provide transparent performance data for every published video



You will be able to see how each piece of content performs. Not every video will become a winner—and that is expected. Success comes from consistently testing new ideas, learning from the data, iterating on promising concepts, and finding the creative that scales.



What We Want to Create



We are especially interested in AI-powered content involving:



Brand and customer storytelling

Educational product content

AI animation and product demonstrations

Problem-and-solution concepts

Ingredient and benefit education

Direct-response sales videos

Unexpected, entertaining, and attention-grabbing ideas

New creative formats that other food and wellness brands are not using



We welcome different creative styles, perspectives, and approaches. You can be located anywhere in the world as long as you produce excellent work, communicate clearly, and deliver consistently.



Who We’re Looking For



This opportunity may be a strong fit if you:



Are an individual AI creator or established creative agency

Have a strong portfolio of AI-generated video content

Understand performance creative and direct-response marketing

Are passionate about using creativity to generate measurable sales

Can follow a brief while contributing original ideas

Are comfortable testing, learning, and iterating

Want your earning potential connected to the performance of your work

Are interested in building a long-term partnership with a high-growth brand



This opportunity is not for everyone. It is specifically for creators and agencies who believe in their work, want significant upside, and are willing to put in the effort required to discover winning creative.



How to Apply



Please share:



Whether you are applying as an individual creator or an agency

Your portfolio and strongest AI-generated videos

Any experience creating performance content for e-commerce brands

Examples of advertisements that generated measurable results

Why you are passionate about performance creative

The AI tools and creative platforms you use

Your weekly creative capacity

How you would approach creating content for chocolate and protein powder



We want to understand your creative style, your passion for performance marketing, and how we can work together to create winning content.



If you are hungry to create, test, improve, and earn based on the results of your work, we would love to hear from you.



When we win you win! We want to be an 8 figure brand and if you can contribute lots of money to be made!

title: Full-Time WFH Client Success Manager — $2,000 Base + Bonuses
description:
JOB OVERVIEW



Full-Time | Monday-Friday | PH Morning / US Evening Coverage



We are hiring Philippines-based Client Success Managers to support U.S. clients during evening hours, especially Pacific Time.



This is a client leadership role, not just support.



You will own the client relationship, keep clients clear and accountable, create momentum, prevent frustration, and escalate risks early.



This role is best for someone with excellent English, strong emotional intelligence, high ownership, and confidence handling high-ticket clients calmly.



Success is measured by retention, trust, communication, accountability, client momentum, and risk prevention.



SALARY



- Ramp / Trial CSM: USD 1,500/month base

- Certified CSM: USD 2,000/month base

- OTE: USD 2,500-3,000+/month with performance bonuses

- Paid twice a month via Wise

- Certification is performance-based, usually reviewed after 30-60 days, and requires consistent performance, quality-control review, and leadership approval



SCHEDULE



- Monday-Friday

- Full-time: 7.5 hours a day; 37.5 hours/week

- Core client coverage: 6 AM-12 PM PH time

- Split shifts are allowed

- Afternoons and early evenings are generally free

- Required team/training meetings may happen around 9 PM-11 PM PH time

- Occasional client calls may run up to 12 PM PH time when needed

- Final schedule will be agreed during hiring and must be sustainable long-term



ABOUT US



We help creators, beginners, coaches, and business owners grow and monetize online using short-form content, AI tools, strategy, coaching, and accountability.



We provide an “80% done-for-you” content and monetization system that helps clients turn short-form content into audience growth, leads, and income.



We have worked with 4,000+ clients since 2019.



Most clients are U.S.-based, and many are age 45+, so patience, clarity, emotional intelligence, and professional English communication are very important.



RESPONSIBILITIES



- Run client kickoff calls using our onboarding framework

- Set clear expectations from day one

- Help clients understand what to do next and why it matters

- Keep clients accountable to action items and deadlines

- Follow up with stuck, quiet, inactive, or delayed clients

- Re-engage clients before momentum is lost

- Respond to client messages within 24 weekday hours

- Close loops and avoid dangling threads

- Handle difficult conversations calmly and professionally

- De-escalate frustrated or emotional clients

- Identify refund, payment, chargeback, cancellation, and satisfaction risks early

description:

Company Vision:

We want to work with you to grow our company while helping you to become a superstar in your field. We value problem solvers, go getters, people with opinions who want to make an impact. You will be on the leading edge of Amazon and online strategies and will be continually improving your knowledge in the pursuit of helping us grow our business.



At the same time, you will be working with a company that values community & family in both our internal and customer facing sides. Our mission is to delight kids & parents with creative craft kits and related products. We are 100% focused on that mission and want you to be there on the ride with us!



That’s where you come in as our next Amazon SEO Manager



Role Purpose

The Amazon SEO Manager owns the organic discoverability and conversion performance of our Amazon catalog by building and executing a disciplined SEO system. This role ensures our listings are consistently optimized with the right keywords, content, and structure, so we rank higher, earn more organic traffic, and convert more shoppers - reducing reliance on paid ads over time.



This person translates keyword research, search query data, and competitor insights into prioritized listing actions (titles, bullets, backend terms, images, A+ content), and ensures SEO work is delivered on a reliable cadence aligned with seasonality, pricing strategy, and key retail events.



What Success Looks Like

A successful Amazon SEO Manager consistently increases organic visibility and conversion by keeping keyword strategy, listings, and metadata current and intentional. This person owns the SEO engine that compounds: better indexing, better rankings, higher CTR, higher CVR, and a stronger organic share of sales—without sacrificing brand quality or compliance.



They run a disciplined cadence of keyword research and refresh, systematically improve listings (titles/bullets/A+/images/backend), and translate data (DR/DD/SQP/SI) into prioritized action. They partner closely with PPC and creative to ensure keyword targets, positioning, and content work together—especially during seasonality, deal events, and pricing shifts.



ONE THING: Drive organic ranking, discoverability, and conversion through consistent keyword research, listing optimization, and SEO execution.



Primary Objectives

Keyword Research & Keyword Refresh System

SEO + Pricing + Event Alignment

Competitive Advantage

Organize and refresh keyword sets (roots + long-tails)

General Listing Optimization (Images, Title, Bullets, A+ Content)

Weekly analysis and seasonal updates

Update keyword focus on listings based on performance and ranking goals

Price Strategy Support (PED, BD, STP, BTP)

SQP/SI review weekly/as needed; identify actions and implement

Competitor analysis weekly/as needed (price/listing/keywords/PPC targets)

Manage Experiments monthly/as needed (title/image/A+ testing)

Target: 30+ FAQs added per month (based on ASIN priority list)

Emergency fixes (suppressed listings, indexing drops, attribute issues)

Weekly SEO/Optimization sync (priority list + actions + blockers)

Weekly PPC alignment (keyword harvesting + targeting coordination)

Weekly creative coordination (assets needed, deadlines, tests)



Key Skills

Strong copy + conversion thinking (CTR/CVR-focused content decisions)

Data literacy (SQP/SI/keyword tools) and action orientation

Organized project management across many ASINs

Experimentation mindset (testing, learning, iterating)

Detail-oriented: clean data, labeled projects, tracked changes

Creative: weekly/as needed (images/A+ needs + seasonal themes)

title: Graphic Designer – Photo Compositing & Marketing Design
description:
We are seeking an experienced, hands-on Graphic Designer with strong traditional design and photo-compositing skills. This position is intended for a designer who can build professional marketing artwork from real product photography, licensed stock photography, typography, and brand assets—not someone whose primary design process depends on AI-generated imagery or template-based design tools.



Responsibilities



* Design posters, digital menu screens, promotional graphics, brochures, signage, menus, advertisements, and other marketing materials.

* Build multi-image compositions using actual product photography and stock photography.

* Professionally isolate and retouch products, remove or replace backgrounds, correct color, clean edges, create realistic shadows, and match lighting, perspective, scale, and depth.

* Transform a client provided creative brief, reference image, sketch, or AI-generated concept into an original, professionally constructed design using real photographic assets.

* Apply strong judgment in typography, visual hierarchy, composition, spacing, color, lighting, balance, and overall mood.

* Prepare accurate, production-ready files for both digital displays and commercial printing.



Required Qualifications



* 3+ years of professional graphic-design experience or an equivalent portfolio demonstrating advanced practical ability.

* Advanced proficiency in Adobe Photoshop, particularly layers, masks, selections, Smart Objects, adjustment layers, retouching, color correction, compositing, blending, and non-destructive editing.

* Strong working proficiency in Adobe Illustrator and InDesign.

* Demonstrated understanding of typography, layout, color theory, visual hierarchy, composition, branding, resolution, RGB/CMYK, and print production.

* Strong experience working with real photography and creating believable, polished photographic compositions.

* Ability to take creative direction and independently translate it into finished visual communication.



Portfolio Requirement



Applicants must submit a portfolio showing original professional work, particularly advertising, food/product marketing, retail, hospitality, menus, posters, signage, or similar commercial design.



The portfolio should demonstrate photo retouching, product isolation, multi-image compositing, typography, layout, and finished print/digital artwork. Applicants should be prepared to provide selected layered source files (PSD/AI/INDD) demonstrating how their work was constructed.



Practical Skills Test



Final candidates will complete a short paid design exercise using a supplied folder of product photographs, logos, copy, and stock images. Candidates will be asked to create a finished promotional design and submit both the final artwork and the organized, layered working file.



We are evaluating the designer’s eye, technical Photoshop ability, composition, typography, photographic realism, attention to detail, and ability to turn creative direction into professional finished artwork—not their ability to generate an image with AI.

title: Strategic Initiatives Lead to the CEO
description:
AI-First | Strategy, Technology & Special Projects

Full-time | Remote | Reports directly to the CEO



Is this you?



You love to learn, grow, and explore. You get energized by figuring things out without much direction. You are tech-savvy, fascinated by AI, and already use it every day. When someone hands you a goal instead of a checklist, you light up.



You want meaningful responsibility, exposure to different parts of a growing company, and the opportunity to keep expanding what you know and what you can carry.



If that sounds like you, this might be one of the most exciting roles you will ever apply for.



About us



DAASS is a US-based online education company building at the frontier of what AI makes possible in education.



We build serious, academic-level education, and we are growing from a course platform into a full institution, including a college accreditation partnership and a complete online academy.



We are an ambitious, fast-moving, and highly collaborative team with a close-knit, family-like culture. We support one another, enjoy working together, and are constantly experimenting with better ways to build, teach, and work using AI.



The role



You will work directly with the CEO on some of the company's most important new initiatives.

You will be handed a mission, given the context and a clear picture of what success looks like, and then expected to run with it. You figure out the path, research what you need to learn, build what needs to be built, involve the right people, and come back with outcomes.



This is not a role where you wait for a detailed checklist.



It is a role for someone who can take an important, ambiguous problem and turn it into something real.



No two months will look the same. Here is the kind of work you may own:

1. Educational projects. Help turn expert knowledge into world-class lessons and learning materials, and build the systems that make our curriculum production run smoothly.

2. Strategic initiatives. Take on major questions such as accreditation pathways for our academy. Research the landscape, evaluate the options, identify the tradeoffs, and return with a clear recommendation and next steps.

3. AI and technology for students. Develop Claude projects, AI-powered learning tools, internal systems, and new applications that make education better for our students.

4. Systems and builds. Work with our developers on our learning platform and other company tools. Write clear specs, review what is built, test carefully, give precise feedback, and keep projects moving.

5. New missions. Take on important projects that may not fit neatly into any existing department yet. Learn the domain quickly, figure out what needs to happen, and build the path forward.



You will constantly be learning new domains, solving new problems, building new things, and growing into whatever you prove you can carry.



What a normal week looks like



-Driving 2 to 3 active missions at different stages

-Researching unfamiliar subjects and becoming knowledgeable quickly

-Writing recommendation memos and turning research into clear decisions

-Building tools, documents, workflows, and systems yourself using AI

-Reviewing work from developers and team members and sending back clear, useful feedback

-Coordinating with the people needed to move a project forward

-Short, direct check-ins with the CEO: what moved, what is blocked, what needs a decision



What we are looking for

1. Self-direction.

You have real examples of being handed an ambiguous goal and delivering a result on your own. This role gives you a lot of freedom, and freedom is the reward for ownership.

2. Systems thinking.

You do not just finish the work. You think about how to build the process, documentation, or system so it runs even better the next time.

3. Strong judgment.

You can sort through a lot of information, identify what actually matters, see tradeoffs, and make a thoughtful recommendation rather than simply presenting options.

4. Attention to detail.

You take pride in getting the small things right, and it shows in everything you produce, including your application.

5. Excellent written English.

Much of your output will be written: research memos, specs, documentation, instructions, feedback, and recommendations. You write clearly, precisely, and quickly.

6. AI fluency.

AI is not an occasional tool here. It is part of how we work. You already use AI tools every day to research, think, draft, build, analyze, automate, or solve problems, and you can show us real examples of how.

7. Curiosity and learning speed.

You enjoy entering a subject you know little about, asking the right questions, learning quickly, and developing enough command of it to make something useful happen.

Even better if you have



Technical fluency. You can write a spec a developer can build from, test software carefully, and build simple apps, dashboards, workflows, or automations yourself with AI tools, even without formal engineering training.



Experience as an operations lead, strategic initiatives lead, right hand to a founder, chief of staff, or founder of your own venture.

Experience owning cross-functional projects from an unclear starting point through completion.



Nice bonuses



-Instructional design or curriculum writing experience

-Real software engineering ability

-Experience working with US-based companies

-Experience building with Claude, ChatGPT, no-code tools, APIs, or AI coding tools



What you get



-Daily work directly with the CEO of a growing company

-A senior role with meaningful responsibility and visibility

-Missions with real weight. What you own truly matters to the business.

-Constant learning across education, AI, technology, operations, and business strategy

-The freedom to figure things out rather than simply execute someone else's checklist

-A role that grows as fast as you do

-A smart, ambitious team that genuinely enjoys building together

-Full-time salary paid in USD



How to apply



Complete the application form at the link below.



It includes a short test mission, and we think you will actually enjoy it. It is designed to feel like the real job: you will be given a problem, some context, and the freedom to figure out what to do with it.



That is also how we find the people who will thrive here.

title: Local PPC
description:
Read this part first



This role has an unusual constraint. Please do not apply until you have read it.



The practice is a healthcare provider, so patient privacy rules prevent us from running normal conversion tracking. Google Analytics on this site records no conversions at all, and it never will. We also cannot pass patient information back to ad platforms the way an ecommerce store would.



That means you cannot manage these campaigns the usual way. There is no tidy conversion column to optimize toward. You will have to build the measurement chain yourself using call tracking, form tracking, and data the practice records at the front desk when a patient books.



If your process depends on smart bidding against on-site conversion data, this role will frustrate you and you will not do well in it. If you have run accounts where you had to work out what was actually happening from imperfect signals, keep reading.



About the work



We manage marketing for a family dental practice in Gilbert, Arizona. Paid search already works here at a small scale and is profitable. We are not trying to rescue a failing account.



The opportunity is a shift in what we buy. General new patient volume is profitable but has almost no room to grow, because the cost per patient is already close to what a general patient is worth. Higher value treatments carry far more headroom, so the plan is to move budget toward searches from people who need bigger work.



We have already done the strategy. We know which patient segments to target, in what order, and which ones to deliberately avoid. What we need is someone to build, run and measure the campaigns properly.



What you will do



Build and run Google Ads campaigns



Build search campaigns for three defined patient segments, in a set sequence, starting with the lowest risk one

Write ad copy and build out keywords, negatives, and ad extensions

Manage budgets, bids, and pacing across a small account

Resolve an open Google Ads policy flag on phone numbers in ad text

Build and test landing pages in coordination with our team



Build the measurement chain (this is the hard part)



Set up call tracking with a separate tracked number per campaign, so we can see call volume and how many calls become booked appointments

Set up form and booking tracking through our online scheduler

Work with the practice so each campaign has its own entry in the front desk intake list, which lets us tie campaigns to actual treatment months later

Import offline conversion data back into Google Ads where we are permitted to



Report on what matters



Report on booked appointments and treatment value, not on clicks and leads. Lead counts alone will mislead us badly in this business and we will not accept them as a success measure

Group results by the month a patient first visited, because high value cases can take 30 to 90 days to complete

Watch the cost of the next patient, not the average across all of them

Weekly written update on what you changed, what happened, and what you recommend next

What we will NOT be buying



Please note these, because they are deliberate decisions based on our data, not oversights:



General cleaning and checkup volume

Emergency and same day pain searches

Pediatric and family checkups

Broad awareness or reach campaigns



If your proposal is to run broad awareness campaigns or scale general patient volume, we are not a fit.



What we need from you

3 or more years managing Google Ads for US-based businesses, with real budget responsibility

You have set up call tracking before (CallRail, WhatConverts, or similar) and understand why it matters

You have imported offline conversions into Google Ads, or you can clearly explain how you would

You are comfortable being measured on downstream revenue rather than lead volume

You can build and test landing pages, or work closely with someone who does

Clear written English. Your weekly reports are how we will know what is happening

Honest reporting. If a campaign is not working, we want to hear it in week two, not month four

Nice to have

Healthcare, dental, or other regulated industry experience

Familiarity with HIPAA constraints on advertising and tracking

Experience with high consideration purchases that take weeks to close

Google Ads certification

s and correspondence

title: Customer Experience Rep- Ecommerce Food Brand
description:
Customer Experience Manager — E-Commerce

About NUTSÓLA



NUTSÓLA is a founder-led food brand built around clean ingredients, transparency, and treating our customers like friends. We believe customer experience is much more than answering questions or resolving tickets—it is an opportunity to educate, build trust, and create lifelong relationships.



We are looking for a thoughtful, compassionate, and highly capable Customer Experience Manager who will work closely with our Founder & CEO to deliver an exceptional experience at every customer touchpoint.



About the Role



The Customer Experience Manager will be responsible for supporting customers with kindness, patience, and genuine care. You will listen carefully, communicate clearly, and take ownership of finding the best possible solution—even when the answer is not immediately obvious.



This is a hands-on role for someone who understands that every interaction represents our brand. You should be comfortable managing day-to-day customer conversations while also identifying recurring issues, improving processes, and sharing customer insights directly with the Founder.



Our goal is not simply to close tickets. Our goal is to make every customer feel heard, valued, and confident choosing NUTSÓLA for years to come.



Responsibilities

Provide warm, thoughtful, and educational support through
, chat, social media, and other customer-service channels.

Manage customer conversations and workflows within Richpanel.

Assist customers with orders, shipping, subscriptions, promotions, product questions, ingredients, and general education.

Communicate in a clear, friendly, and natural voice that feels personal—not scripted or transactional.

Take ownership of customer concerns from beginning to resolution.

Find fair and thoughtful solutions that protect both the customer relationship and the company.

Work directly with the Founder & CEO on escalations, customer feedback, policies, and opportunities to improve the overall experience.

Use Shopify to review orders, customer history, discounts, refunds, replacements, and other account information.

Identify recurring questions or problems and recommend improvements to products, policies, website content, and internal processes.



Help create and maintain customer-service templates, educational resources, and standard operating procedures.

Follow up proactively when necessary rather than waiting for customers to contact us again.

Track customer experience trends and help improve customer satisfaction, response time, resolution quality, and retention.

Serve as the voice of the customer across the company.

Required Experience



At least 1.5 years of customer experience or customer-support experience within an e-commerce business.

Hands-on experience using both Richpanel and Shopify.

Exceptional written and verbal communication skills.

Strong judgment and the ability to resolve problems independently.

Experience handling refunds, replacements, shipping issues, subscriptions, order changes, and product questions.

Ability to manage multiple conversations while maintaining accuracy and attention to detail.

Comfortable working closely and communicating directly with a founder.



Who You Are

You genuinely care about people and want customers to feel supported.

You are kind, patient, empathetic, and emotionally intelligent.

You communicate clearly and never leave customers confused.

You are solution-oriented and do not give up when an issue requires extra effort.

You take ownership instead of passing problems to someone else.

You understand how to balance generosity with good business judgment.

You are organized, dependable, and able to follow through consistently.

You are comfortable receiving feedback and continuously improving.

You enjoy educating customers and explaining products in an approachable way.

You notice patterns and look for ways to prevent future customer issues.

What Makes This Role Different



At NUTSÓLA, customer experience is one of the most important parts of the business. You will not be expected to rush through conversations or rely on impersonal responses. You will have the opportunity to build real relationships, help shape our customer-experience strategy, and work directly with the Founder to make meaningful improvements.



Success in this position means customers feel like they are speaking with someone who listens, cares, and will do everything reasonable to help them.



How to Apply



Please submit your resume along with a brief introduction explaining:



Your experience using Richpanel and Shopify.

Why you believe exceptional customer experience is important.

An example of a difficult customer situation you personally resolved and how you handled it.

title: Customer Success Account Manager – $2,000 Base p/m + Bonuses
description:
JOB OVERVIEW



Full-Time | Monday-Friday | PH Morning / US Evening Coverage



We are hiring Philippines-based Client Success Managers to support U.S. clients during evening hours, especially Pacific Time.



This is a client leadership role, not just support.



You will own the client relationship, keep clients clear and accountable, create momentum, prevent frustration, and escalate risks early.



This role is best for someone with excellent English, strong emotional intelligence, high ownership, and confidence handling high-ticket clients calmly.



Success is measured by retention, trust, communication, accountability, client momentum, and risk prevention.



SALARY



- Ramp / Trial CSM: USD 1,500/month base

- Certified CSM: USD 2,000/month base

- OTE: USD 2,500-3,000+/month with performance bonuses

- Paid twice a month via Wise

- Certification is performance-based, usually reviewed after 30-60 days, and requires consistent performance, quality-control review, and leadership approval



SCHEDULE



- Monday-Friday

- Full-time: 7.5 hours a day; 37.5 hours/week

- Core client coverage: 6 AM-12 PM PH time

- Split shifts are allowed

- Afternoons and early evenings are generally free

- Required team/training meetings may happen around 9 PM-11 PM PH time

- Occasional client calls may run up to 12 PM PH time when needed

- Final schedule will be agreed during hiring and must be sustainable long-term



ABOUT US



We help creators, beginners, coaches, and business owners grow and monetize online using short-form content, AI tools, strategy, coaching, and accountability.



We provide an “80% done-for-you” content and monetization system that helps clients turn short-form content into audience growth, leads, and income.



We have worked with 4,000+ clients since 2019.



Most clients are U.S.-based, and many are age 45+, so patience, clarity, emotional intelligence, and professional English communication are very important.



RESPONSIBILITIES



- Run client kickoff calls using our onboarding framework

- Set clear expectations from day one

- Help clients understand what to do next and why it matters

- Keep clients accountable to action items and deadlines

- Follow up with stuck, quiet, inactive, or delayed clients

- Re-engage clients before momentum is lost

- Respond to client messages within 24 weekday hours

- Close loops and avoid dangling threads

- Handle difficult conversations calmly and professionally

- De-escalate frustrated or emotional clients

- Identify refund, payment, chargeback, cancellation, and satisfaction risks early

- Escalate issues quickly according to SOPs

- Keep clear notes in Airtable / CRM

- Coordinate internally when support or escalation is needed

- Support renewals, referrals, testimonials, and upsell opportunities when appropriate

- Join required trainings, daily team Zoom calls, and feedback sessions

- Once activated, host a weekly client-support call or own a similar client-success responsibility



CLIENT LOAD



You will ramp gradually.



The target for a Certified CSM is 40-50 active clients, depending on client complexity, program type, and client inflow.



When fewer clients are available, CSMs may support reactivation, offboarding, client check-ins, and legacy-client cleanup.



BENEFITS



- Fully remote role

- Payment: Twice a month via Wise, always on time

- Performance-based bonuses

- Clear path from Ramp / Trial CSM to Certified CSM

- Growth opportunity into leadership

- Supportive international team

- Daily trainings and team Zoom calls

- SOPs, support, and structure provided

- Work with creators, brands, short-form content, and AI tools

- Required tools paid for after the test month where applicable

- Afternoons and early evenings generally free, with required evening meetings



REQUIREMENTS



- Currently based in the Philippines

- Fluent, professional English

- Clear and easily understood verbal communication

- Strong communication and emotional intelligence

- Calm under pressure

- High ownership, follow-through, and reliability

- Strong say-do ratio and respect for deadlines

- Comfortable handling difficult, emotional, or high-ticket clients

- Comfortable with uncomfortable conversations

- Strong Airtable / CRM documentation habits

- Reliable internet connection and professional home setup

- Willing to use Hubstaff during working hours

- Able to work PH morning / U.S. evening hours

- Comfortable with split shifts and required evening meetings

- Able to manage up to 40-50 active clients once trained and certified

- Able to meet certification standards without heavy supervision

- Able to identify and escalate refund, payment, chargeback, cancellation, and client-satisfaction risks quickly



NICE TO HAVE EXPERIENCE

- High-ticket programs

- Social media monetization

- Content strategy

- Creator economy

WE’RE THE RIGHT FIT IF

title: Senior UI/UX & Motion Designer (SaaS AI Products) — Remote, Full-Time
description:
Job Summary



Aureate Labs is looking for a Senior UI/UX & Motion Designer to own the design of our SaaS AI products end-to-end — from Figma screens and design systems through to promotional and explainer videos that show our products to the world. This is a long-term, full-time remote role working directly with our founder and development team across multiple active products. Do well here and there is a genuine growth path, including the possibility of an in-office role with us in the future.



About Us



Aureate Enterprise T/A Aureate Labs builds SaaS products powered by AI. We're a small, fast-moving team with multiple products in active development — which means your work ships quickly, your designs get used by real customers, and you'll never be a small cog in a big machine. You'll be our go-to design person across product and marketing.



What You'll Do:



Product Design (primary — roughly 70%)



-Design clean, modern UI for our SaaS web applications in Figma — dashboards, onboarding flows, forms, settings, data-heavy screens



-Build and maintain a reusable component library / design system so our products stay consistent as they grow



-Turn rough briefs and feature ideas into wireframes, then high-fidelity designs ready for developer handoff



-Work directly with our developer — organized Figma files, auto-layout, clear specs and annotations



-Iterate based on feedback, user behavior, and product priorities



Motion & Video (secondary — roughly 30%)



-Create promotional videos for social media (short-form, product highlights, feature announcements)



-Produce SaaS explainer videos — animated product walkthroughs with motion graphics (After Effects or similar; 2.5D style)



-Design supporting marketing creative: ad graphics, landing page visuals, social media assets



Requirements

Must have:



-5+ years of UI/UX design experience, with real SaaS / web app product work in your portfolio (not just landing pages or graphics)



-Expert-level Figma — components, auto-layout, prototyping, developer handoff



-Motion graphics / video editing skills — After Effects, Premiere, or equivalent, with examples we can watch



-A portfolio and/or showreel you can share (Figma, Behance, Dribbble, YouTube, Vimeo, or personal site)



-Strong English communication — you'll work directly with the founder and dev team



-Full-time availability (8 hours/day) and reliable internet with backup





Nice to have:



-Experience designing AI product interfaces (chat UIs, AI assistants, automation tools)



-3D or 2.5D explainer video experience (Blender, Cinema 4D, Spline)



-Basic understanding of HTML/CSS so your designs are practical to build



-Experience with AI design/video tools (Runway, Midjourney, etc.)



-Familiarity working alongside AI-assisted development workflows





What We Offer



PHP60,000 – PHP100,000+/month, depending on experience — and we're happy to go beyond this range for an exceptional candidate, so don't self-select out if you're above it



-13th month pay



-Paid time off + paid sick days



-Long-term, stable full-time role — we're building products, not running a one-off project



-Work directly with the founder — your ideas actually shape the product



-Variety: product UI one week, launch video the next — never repetitive



-Growth path as Aureate Labs expands, including the possibility of transitioning to an in-office role in the future for the right person





How to Apply:



Apply with your updated resume and include:



-Your portfolio link showing SaaS/app UI work



-Your updated resume/CV



-Your video/motion reel (or links to 2–3 videos you've made)





Applications without a portfolio and reel will not be considered — for this role, your work speaks louder than your resume.



To confirm you've read this post, start your application with the word "GOLDEN." Applications without it won't be reviewed.
