title: Marketing Operations Assistant
description:
About Us & Your Role

We’re building and scaling high-velocity DTC brands.

The pace is fast. The standards are high. The upside is massive.

We’re hiring a Marketing Operations Assistant to become the executional backbone of the marketing team.

You’ll own the systems that keep everything running:

Ad scheduling

Tracking sheets

Reporting

Comment extraction

Day-to-day marketing operations

You’ll also take on new initiatives and ad hoc projects:

UGC sourcing & coordination

Influencer outreach

Competitor research

One-off high-priority projects

Anything that falls outside a clear owner — you take it and run with it.

You’ll work directly with our Head of Meta, acting as their right-hand.

The goal is simple:

Take things off their plate. Execute them fully. 

We’re looking for someone who:

Figures things out

Moves fast

Solves problems

Improves systems

If you’re organized, resourceful, and take pride in being the person who gets things done without being chased — you’ll thrive here.

If you need constant direction, prefer predictable work, or move slowly — this won’t be the right fit.

We’re building something rare.

If you want in, let’s talk.



Key Responsibilities

Own and manage the day-to-day marketing operations — ensuring core systems like ad scheduling, tracking, reporting, and comment extraction run smoothly and on time.

Build and own the UGC and influencer pipeline from scratch — sourcing creators, managing outreach, coordinating deliverables, and turning it into a repeatable, scalable system.

Execute high-priority and ad hoc projects end-to-end — taking ideas or tasks and fully running with them without needing constant direction.

Conduct ongoing competitor and market research — identifying new creative angles, trends, and insights to support the marketing team.

Support campaign execution on Meta — assisting with launches, adjustments, and resolving operational issues when needed.

Coordinate across the marketing team to ensure projects, deliverables, and campaigns move forward without delays or breakdowns.

Identify inefficiencies and improve workflows — finding ways to make processes faster, cleaner, and more reliable, including leveraging AI or automation where applicable.



Requirements

3+ years of experience in an operations, marketing, or execution-focused role (e-commerce or DTC experience is a strong plus).

Highly resourceful and able to figure things out independently without step-by-step instructions.

Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks, systems, and priorities at once.

High attention to detail — able to catch small errors and maintain accuracy across tasks, data, and deliverables.

Fast executor — able to move quickly, handle high workload, and complete tasks without unnecessary delays.

Comfortable using AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, etc.) to accelerate workflows, research, and problem-solving.

Clear and responsive communicator — able to work effectively with different team members and keep things moving.



Why Us

title: Virtual Stylist & Wardrobe Curator (Hourly, Temporary)
description:

I’m looking for a thoughtful, fashion-minded virtual stylist to help me bring order, creativity, and fresh vision to my existing wardrobe. I’ve already photographed my clothes, shoes, bags, and jewelry. Now, I need your eye to help me put it all together.



This is a remote position where you’ll help me create styled looks for different parts of my life: speaking engagements, church services, real estate client meetings, casual outings, travel days, and formal events. We’ll use the Indyx iOS app to build and organize my wardrobe, and I’ll cover the premium subscription if needed.



You won’t need to shop for me or build a wardrobe from scratch. I simply need help refining and coordinating what I already own into outfits that are appropriate, elegant, and true to who I am.



A Little About Me



I’m a minister, real estate broker, and author based in Tennessee. I show up in many different spaces — from pulpits to closing tables to Sunday brunch — and I want my wardrobe to reflect confidence, modesty, purpose, and grace. My style is a blend of sophistication and professionalism, with a touch of Afrocentric flair.



What You’ll Be Doing:

Access my wardrobe photos inside the Indyx app and help me organize them by category, color, and occasion

Create polished and appropriate outfits for specific events like:



Sunday services

Real estate closings and networking

Speaking engagements (in person and virtual)

Brunch or lunch with friends

Travel and formal events

Build lookbooks and mood boards in the app so I can easily find what to wear

Tag each item and outfit with helpful details like occasion, season, and location

Suggest styling adjustments, accessory pairings, or layering options

Use the app’s built-in photo editor to clean up background images and help the catalog look its best

Provide brief notes or explanations for each outfit so I understand how to pull it together myself



What I’m Looking For:



Someone with experience in styling, wardrobe curation, or fashion coordination

A person who understands how to work with modest, professional, ministry-appropriate clothing

Comfortable using iOS and willing to work inside the Indyx app (training provided if needed)

Organized and good at communicating clearly and kindly

Someone who enjoys helping others look and feel their best

Bonus if you have experience building digital lookbooks or working with speakers or professionals

Details:



This is a short-term project paid by the hour

Please include your hourly rate when you apply



We’ll begin with a paid trial task (such as styling 3 to 5 looks) and move from there



I’d love to get started right away, with the project expected to last around 3 to 4 weeks, depending on how we pace it



To Apply



Please send:



A short introduction about yourself and your styling background

Your hourly rate

Any examples of work you’ve done; especially for clients who speak, teach, or lead professionally

Confirmation that you use an iOS device and are open to working inside the Indyx app

title: Multi Brand Marketing Specialist (Graveyard Shift, Remote)
description:
TYPE OF WORK: Full Time 

WAGE / SALARY: Dependent on level of experience and demonstrated knowledge

HOURS PER WEEK: 45-60



!!Read This First!!



We run a portfolio of companies across mental health, medical tourism, and wellness. We are hiring two to three marketers who can build, ship, and improve across all of them.



This role is execution heavy and proof driven. Every claim you make in your application will be checked against work you can show us. If you cannot prove it, do not claim it.



What You Will Actually Do



- Write sales copy that converts, from hook to checkout

- Build and maintain funnels and websites in GoHighLevel

- Launch paid campaigns on Meta and Google that produce booked leads and sales

- Plan and run content across Instagram,
, TikTok, YouTube, Spotify,
, sms, websites, funnels, and more.

- Edit video that holds attention, including YouTube content

- Design static assets, thumbnails, and full web pages

- Implement tracking across every funnel, website, and campaign, then read the numbers and iterate

- Build a marketing plan for each brand on each platform, then execute it, test, analyze and iterate.

- Stay ahead of platform trends and bring them to us before we ask



What You Must Prove



You will be asked to show the work. Screenshots, dashboards, live links, starting numbers and ending numbers. Applications built on claims we cannot verify go in the reject pile.



Have ready:



- Sales copy you wrote, the funnel it lived in, and what it converted at

- Paid campaigns you ran, with spend managed, ROAS, and cost per lead

- Tracking you set up yourself: pixels, conversions API, GA4, GTM, GHL workflows and attribution

- Video you edited and thumbnails you designed

- Websites or landing pages you built, with live URLs

- Accounts or channels you grew, with the time window and the starting point

- North American, European, or Australian refereneces who are willing to speak to us and confirm your claims



Non Negotiables



- Graveyard shift. Hard requirement, no exceptions.

- Full time, 45-60 hours per week, available immediately

- Quiet home office, your own computer, fast and stable internet, noise cancelling headphones

- You carry several brands at once without us chasing you for updates



How to Apply (Read Carefully)



Two items are mandatory. If you cannot send both, do not apply. This is for serious applicants only.



1. A portfolio of work you personally shipped. Links, case studies, and screenshots with real numbers.



2. A voice memo answering every question below. Upload it to Google Drive, set the link to public access, and include the link in your written application. Applications without an audio file are ignored.



Voice Memo Questions



1. Your digital marketing and social media experience, with specific brands, dates, and numbers (this is where you sell yourself)

2. Sales copy and funnels you have written and built, and what they converted at

3. Paid ads: platforms, monthly spend you managed, ROAS, and cost per lead

4. Tracking you have implemented yourself, and how you used that data to change a campaign

5. YouTube channels you worked on, your role, and what happened to the channel

6. Your design, video editing, and website tools, with an honest comfort level for each

7. Your SEO experience and the results it produced

8. How you run several brands at once without anything slipping

9. A time the numbers told you to kill something you believed in, and what you did next

10. Admin or virtual assistant experience

11. Cold calling or outbound experience

12. Confirmation you can work the graveyard shift

13. Your home situation, office setup, internet speed, computer, headphones, and any distractions such as children, pets, or family

14. Whether you can start immediately, full time

15. Your expected compensation and why you are worth it



How to Stand Out



The people who get hired do more than answer the questions. They sell themselves the way they sell a brand. 



Send us:



- A short marketing video pitching yourself as your own client. Show us your hook, your editing, and your personality.

- Case studies with numbers in context. Vanity metrics with no context will not impress us.

- A mock concept for one of our industries: a hook, a thumbnail, or a 30 second idea. It does not need to be perfect. It needs to show us how you think.



What Gets You Passed Over



No voice memo. No portfolio. Generic answers. Metrics with no context. Anything you cannot back up.



Skills Required



Performance marketing, direct response copywriting, funnel building, paid media, conversion tracking and analytics, video editing, graphic design, web design.

title: WordPress Directory Developer — Long-Term Opportunity
description:
Company: TDM Media LLC

Initial Project: Roof Response Network

Platform: DirectoryOS

Work Arrangement: Remote

Initial Compensation: $8–$15 USD/hour, depending on experience and demonstrated technical ability

Initial Hours: Approximately 15–25 hours per week, with opportunity to increase

Long-Term Opportunity: Salaried (eventually) / Full-Time Position



About the Opportunity



TDM Media LLC is building a portfolio of niche, data-driven directory websites designed to help consumers find and connect with local service providers.



Our first project is Roof Response Network, a nationwide roofing contractor directory.



However, we are not looking for someone simply to build one WordPress website.



We are developing a reusable platform called DirectoryOS that will eventually power multiple directory businesses across different industries.



We are looking for a WordPress developer who would like to grow with us long term.



The position will begin on an hourly basis, including a paid test project. As the platform launches, revenue grows, and we establish a successful working relationship, our goal is to transition the right person into a stable salaried/full-time position.



For us, quality matters more than simply finding the lowest hourly rate. We are looking for someone who can build things correctly, work efficiently, communicate well, and become a trusted long-term member of our team.



What You'll Be Building



Our initial project will use WordPress and Directorist to create a scalable directory platform.



You will help us build and configure:



WordPress

Directorist

Bricks Builder

Structured contractor listings

Custom listing fields

Categories and taxonomies

City/state/location structures

Search and filtering

Contractor profile pages

Directory search-results pages

Maps and location functionality

CSV/data imports

SEO-friendly directory architecture

Lead-capture forms

Mobile-responsive layouts

Performance and security configuration



We will also be working with structured business data collected and enriched through tools such as Apify, APIs, and other data sources.



You do not need to be an Apify expert, but you should be comfortable working with structured data, CSV files, custom fields, imports, APIs, and WordPress databases.



The Type of Developer We're Looking For



We are looking for someone who understands WordPress as a development platform—not simply someone who installs themes and page builders.



You should be comfortable thinking through a workflow such as:



Data Source → Structured Data → WordPress Fields → Directory Listings → Search/Filters → User Experience



Strong candidates will have experience with several of the following:



WordPress development

Directorist or similar directory plugins

Bricks Builder

Custom post types and custom fields

WordPress taxonomies

WP All Import or similar import tools

Large CSV imports

APIs and JSON

PHP

JavaScript

HTML/CSS

Git/GitHub

WordPress performance optimization

Technical SEO/schema

Cloudflare

Cloudways or similar managed WordPress hosting



Experience with Apify, web scraping, automation, or large directory websites is a major plus.



You do not need to already know every tool in our technology stack. Strong technical fundamentals, problem-solving ability, willingness to learn, and demonstrated ability to build reliable systems are more important to us than checking every box.



Our Development Philosophy



We want to build a platform that is maintainable and reusable.



Our general approach is:



Configure before customizing.

Customize before custom coding.



We don't want unnecessary custom code when WordPress or an established plugin already provides a reliable solution.



At the same time, you should be capable of writing clean custom code when it is genuinely necessary.



Everything we build should be designed with future directories in mind.



We care about building things correctly the first time rather than choosing shortcuts that create technical problems later.



First Project



Your first project will be a paid assignment involving part of the DirectoryOS / Roof Response Network platform.



Candidates who successfully complete the paid assignment may be selected to continue with the full project.



The first development sprint will focus on establishing the WordPress environment, configuring the core directory platform, creating the initial listing structure, and producing a working prototype using sample contractor data.



Detailed specifications and relevant training resources will be provided to the selected developer.



Training & Documentation



We have invested in specialized training covering the directory-building methods and tools we intend to use.



The selected developer will receive access to the relevant portions of this training along with our own DirectoryOS documentation.



You will not be expected to figure out the entire project from scratch.



We have documented the product vision, technology stack, architecture, development backlog, and initial sprint.



We want our developer spending time building, not guessing what we want.



Communication & Working Hours



TDM Media LLC is based in the United States and operates on U.S. Eastern Time (ET).



Most development work can be completed asynchronously, and we do not expect you to work an entire U.S. overnight schedule.



However, regular communication and some overlap with U.S. Eastern Time will be important.



The company owner currently works another business role from approximately 9:00 AM–5:30 PM Eastern Time Monday through Friday, so we would prefer a developer who can provide some availability after those hours.



Ideally, you should be able to provide:



-1–2 hours of overlap between approximately 6:00 PM and 9:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time on agreed weekdays when needed

-Reasonable weekend availability for occasional project meetings, demonstrations, planning sessions, or troubleshooting

-Regular written progress updates that can be reviewed asynchronously

-Timely responses to questions or issues that could block development



You will not necessarily be expected to attend a meeting every day. We want development time spent building rather than sitting in unnecessary meetings.



Our goal is to establish a predictable communication schedule that works well for both sides.



You should be comfortable:



-Providing regular progress updates

-Asking questions when requirements are unclear

-Explaining technical decisions in plain English

-Documenting important configuration and custom development

-Demonstrating completed work

-Receiving feedback and making revisions

-Working from written requirements and acceptance criteria

-Proactively identifying blockers rather than waiting until a deadline



We value reliability and transparency more than pretending to know everything.



If you encounter a problem, tell us. We would rather solve it together early than discover it weeks later.



Long-Term Potential



This is not intended to be a one-time website project.



Our goal is to build multiple directory businesses using the DirectoryOS platform.



As those businesses grow, there should be ongoing work involving:



-New directory launches

-New features

-Data integrations

-SEO/AEO improvements

-Automation

-Performance improvements

-Maintenance

-Testing

-Platform improvements



We would love to find someone who eventually knows DirectoryOS extremely well and becomes a key long-term member of TDM Media LLC.



The position will initially be hourly at approximately 15–25 hours per week while we complete the first project and establish a successful working relationship.



Hours can increase as development needs grow.



As the company generates revenue and the relationship proves successful, our intention is to transition the right person into a stable salaried/full-time role with TDM Media LLC.



We are looking for someone interested in the opportunity to grow with the company rather than simply complete a single website project.



Confidentiality & Ownership



Because you will be working with proprietary business processes, software configurations, data structures, development methods, and other intellectual property, the selected developer will be required to sign a Confidentiality/Nondisclosure and Intellectual Property Agreement before receiving access to proprietary materials and production systems.



All work product created for TDM Media LLC as part of the engagement will be owned by TDM Media LLC according to the terms of that agreement.



How to Apply



Please answer all of the following questions in your application.



1. How many years have you worked with WordPress?



2. Have you built a directory, marketplace, classified, real-estate, job-board, or other database-driven WordPress website? 

Please provide examples and explain specifically what you built.



3. Have you used Directorist? If yes, describe your experience. If not, which similar directory plugins have you used?



4. Have you worked with Bricks Builder? If yes, describe your experience.



5. Tell us about the largest CSV or dataset you have imported into WordPress. What tools did you use, and how did you handle duplicates or errors?



6. What experience do you have working with APIs, JSON, custom fields, custom post types, or WordPress taxonomies?



7. Have you used Apify or other web-scraping/data-collection tools? If yes, please explain.



8. How comfortable are you with Git and GitHub?



9. When would you choose custom PHP/JavaScript instead of using an existing WordPress plugin?



10. If you were given 50,000 business records containing business name, address, phone number, website, categories, latitude/longitude, and service areas, briefly explain how you would approach importing those records into a WordPress directory.



11. What city/country and time zone are you currently located in?



12. What are your normal working hours in your local time?



13. Are you able to provide 1–2 hours of working/meeting overlap between approximately 6:00 PM and 9:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time on agreed weekdays when needed? Please tell us what hours would work best for you.



14. Are you available for occasional weekend meetings or project demonstrations if scheduled in advance?



15. How many hours per week are you currently available to work with TDM Media LLC?



16. Do you currently have another full-time job or long-term client commitment? If yes, please explain your schedule and approximately how many hours per week it requires.

title: High Ticket Closer (Base Plus Commission, Graveyard Shift, Remote)
description:
TYPE OF WORK: Full Time

HOURS PER WEEK: 45

COMPENSATION: 20,000 PHP monthly base plus 5 to 10% commission on closed deals



Read This First



We run a portfolio of companies across mental health, medical tourism, and wellness. Our offers range from $500 to $24,000 USD. We are hiring closers who already know how to sell at that level and can prove it with numbers.



This is a closing role. You will speak to people making real decisions about their health, their families, and their money. We want a professional who can hold a serious conversation and ask for the sale without pressure tactics.



The Money



- 20,000 PHP monthly base salary

- 5 to 10% commission on closed deals, based on offer and performance tier

- Deal sizes range from $500 to $24,000 USD

- One deal at the top of the range pays $1,200 to $2,400 USD in commission

- Commission is paid on collected revenue, including payment plan installments as they clear

- Your earning ceiling is set by your close rate, not by us



What You Will Actually Do



- Run discovery and closing calls with inbound leads by phone and Zoom

- Work outbound on aged leads, no shows, and reactivations

- Follow up on a structured cadence for 30 to 90 days before a lead is dead

- Close in DMs and by voice note where the offer calls for it

- Handle payment plan and financing conversations with confidence

- Log every call, note, objection, and next step in the CRM the same day

- Hit weekly targets on calls made, show rate, close rate, and cash collected

- Report objection patterns back to marketing so the front end gets fixed

- Sell across several brands and several price points without confusing them



Requirements



- Five or more years of closing experience with documented results

- Formal sales training you can name. Tell us the framework you run and where you learned it.

- Prior experience in a commission based environment where your income depended on your performance

- Proven high ticket experience, meaning deals above $2,000 USD closed by you personally

- Strong phone and video presence, clear English, clean audio

- CRM discipline. GoHighLevel experience is a strong advantage.

- Objection handling and pipeline management as a system, not as instinct

- Self starter. Nobody here will hover over your dialer.

- Emotional steadiness. Some of these conversations are heavy.

- North American, European or Australian references who are willing to speak with us and confirm exactly what you are claiming.



Ethics Are Part of the Job



Our clients include people in crisis, families under strain, and patients considering surgery. High pressure closing, false urgency, and promises we cannot keep will end your employment immediately. We want closers who sell hard and stay honest.



Non Negotiables



- Graveyard shift to cover North American business hours. Hard requirement, no exceptions.

- Full time, 45 hours per week, available immediately

- Quiet home office, your own computer, and a headset with a noise cancelling microphone

- Fast, stable internet with a backup connection and a power backup plan

- No background noise on calls. Ever.



How to Apply (Read Carefully)



Three items are mandatory. If you cannot send all three, do not apply. This is for serious applicants only.



1. Proof of your numbers. Commission statements, CRM dashboards, leaderboard screenshots, or payout records. Redact anything confidential. We are looking for cash collected, close rate, and average deal size.



2. A call sample. A recording of you closing or handling an objection, shared only if you have the right to share it. If you cannot share a recording, send a live role play instead: pick an offer, invent an objection, and handle it out loud.



3. A voice memo answering every question below. Upload it to Google Drive, set the link to public access, and include the link in your application. Applications without an audio file are ignored.



Voice Memo Questions



1. Companies you closed for, what the offer was, the price point, and the dates

2. Your best twelve months: cash collected, close rate off booked calls, and average deal size

3. The sales training you completed and which framework you actually run on a call

4. The commission structure you worked under and what you earned monthly under it

5. The highest ticket deal you personally closed and how that call went

6. Your exact follow up process for a lead who goes cold after a strong call

7. The objection you hear most and the words you use to handle it

8. CRMs, dialers, and tracking tools you have used

9. A deal you walked away from and why

10. How you keep your pipeline organized when you carry several offers at once

11. What you do on a week where you are behind on target

12. Confirmation you can work the graveyard shift

13. Your home office setup, internet speed, backup power, headset, and any distractions such as children, pets, or family

14. Whether you can start immediately, full time

15. Your target monthly commission and what you will do to hit it



What Gets You Passed Over



No proof of numbers. No voice memo. Vague answers about "helping the team." Close rates with no denominator. Anyone who has never carried a quota. Anyone who needs to be managed to pick up the phone.



Skills Required



High ticket closing, consultative sales, objection handling, pipeline and CRM management, outbound prospecting, follow up systems, payment plan conversion.

title: Property Acquisition Virtual Assistant / Real Estate Investment Cold Caller
description:
We are a U.S.-based real estate investment company seeking a professional, reliable, and motivated Virtual Assistant to help identify homeowners who may be interested in selling their property directly to our investment company.



This is NOT a real estate agent or brokerage position. Our company is seeking to purchase properties for its own investment purposes and portfolio.



ABOUT THE ROLE



You will make outbound calls to property owners using company-provided lead lists and approved calling systems. Your goal is to determine whether a homeowner may be interested in discussing a potential direct sale of their property to our investment company.



You are the first voice homeowners will hear from our company, so we are looking for someone who sounds professional, confident, friendly, and natural.



This is NOT a script-reading robot position. You should be able to listen, build rapport, ask appropriate questions, handle rejection professionally, and have a genuine conversation.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



• Make outbound calls to property owners using company-provided lead lists and approved systems.



• Follow company-approved scripts, calling procedures, calling hours, and compliance requirements.



• Clearly and truthfully identify yourself and the investment company you are calling on behalf of.



• Ask property owners whether they would consider selling their property directly to our investment company.



• Have friendly and professional conversations with homeowners.



• Identify homeowners who have a genuine interest in discussing a potential sale.



• Gather approved basic information from interested homeowners, such as property condition, occupancy, motivation for potentially selling, expected timeline, and whether the homeowner has a price in mind.



• Accurately document calls, conversations, notes, follow-ups, and outcomes in our CRM.



• Categorize leads based on the homeowner's level of interest.



• Schedule a follow-up conversation with the company owner when a homeowner expresses genuine interest in discussing a potential sale.



• Conduct approved follow-up calls when instructed.



• Immediately document any request from a homeowner not to receive additional calls and follow company procedures to prevent additional outreach.



• Provide regular reporting regarding calls, conversations, interested property owners, follow-ups, and CRM activity.



IMPORTANT — REAL ESTATE LICENSING COMPLIANCE



This position is for a real estate investment company seeking to acquire properties for its OWN account and investment portfolio.



This is NOT a real estate brokerage position.



Although the owner of the investment company may separately hold a New Jersey real estate license, this position is for the property investment/acquisition business and NOT for soliciting brokerage clients or real estate listings.



The Virtual Assistant must follow all company policies designed to comply with applicable federal, state, and local requirements, including applicable New Jersey Real Estate Commission requirements.



YOU WILL NOT:



• Represent yourself as a real estate agent, Realtor®, broker, attorney, appraiser, or other licensed professional.



• Solicit homeowners to list their property with a real estate agent or brokerage.



• Solicit listing agreements or brokerage relationships.



• Offer brokerage or real estate representation services.



• Represent third-party buyers or sellers.



• Provide legal, tax, financing, appraisal, brokerage, or real estate advice.



• Provide an appraisal, CMA, or opinion regarding property value.



• Negotiate the purchase or sale of real estate.



• Make binding purchase offers or agree to purchase prices or other material contract terms on behalf of the company.



• Prepare, modify, interpret, explain, or execute real estate contracts.



• Discuss real estate commissions or brokerage compensation.



• Perform activities requiring a real estate license unless properly licensed and specifically authorized.



When a homeowner expresses genuine interest in potentially selling, your responsibility is to gather the approved information, accurately document the lead, and refer the homeowner to the company owner for further discussion.



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



• Excellent spoken English — clear, confident, and easy to understand on a U.S. phone call.



• Strong communication and listening skills.



• Previous outbound cold-calling experience strongly preferred.



• Experience calling U.S. homeowners strongly preferred.



• Previous U.S. real estate investment cold-calling experience is a major plus.



• Comfortable with rejection and high call volume.



• Able to have natural conversations rather than simply reading a script.



• Friendly and professional without being aggressive or misleading.



• Organized and disciplined with CRM data entry and follow-up.



• Reliable and punctual.



• Quiet home workspace.



• Quality headset and microphone.



• Reliable high-speed internet connection.



• Backup internet connection strongly preferred.



• Reliable computer capable of operating web-based CRM and calling software.



• Spanish-speaking ability is a plus but NOT required.



TOOLS & TRAINING



The company will provide or designate the approved:



• Lead lists

• Calling/dialer system

• Calling scripts

• CRM

• Training

• Lead qualification procedures

• Calling and compliance procedures



PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS



Performance will be evaluated based on:



• Consistent outbound calling activity

• Number and quality of live homeowner conversations

• Qualified/interested property-owner leads generated

• Follow-up completion

• CRM accuracy

• Reliability and attendance

• Professional communication

• Compliance with company procedures



100% CRM documentation and compliance with company calling procedures are expected.



The first 30 days will be a PAID TRIAL PERIOD. Strong performance can lead to a long-term position, additional hours, increased responsibility, and compensation reviews as the company grows.



COMPLIANCE — READ CAREFULLY



All outbound calling must be conducted using company-approved lead lists, systems, scripts, calling hours, and procedures.



The VA may not independently purchase, import, source, or begin calling their own lists unless specifically authorized by the company.



The VA must never misrepresent their identity, the company they represent, the purpose of the call, their licensing status, or their authority.



If someone asks not to receive additional calls, the VA must immediately document the request and follow company procedures to prevent additional outreach.



The VA must follow all company policies regarding applicable Do-Not-Call requirements, telephone solicitation requirements, calling restrictions, privacy, caller identification, and recordkeeping.



Compliance is a condition of employment. Failure to follow company procedures may result in immediate termination.



HOW TO APPLY



Applications that do not include ALL of the following may not be reviewed.



1. Send a short message explaining:



• Why you are good on the phone

• Your previous cold-calling experience

• Whether you have called U.S. homeowners

• Whether you have worked for a U.S. real estate investor

• Approximately how many outbound calls you made per day

• Which dialers and CRMs you have used

• Your desired hourly rate

• Your availability during U.S. Eastern Time



2. Submit a 60–90 SECOND VOICE RECORDING role-playing this scenario:



You are calling a homeowner on behalf of our real estate investment company because our company is interested in purchasing properties in their area.



The homeowner says:



“I wasn't really planning on selling, but I guess I'd consider it if the price made sense.”



Continue the conversation naturally.



Your objective is to determine whether the homeowner is genuinely interested and gather appropriate basic information. Do NOT negotiate a purchase price, make an offer, provide a property valuation, or provide real estate advice.



3. Send your resume and briefly describe the best cold-calling or lead-generation results you have personally achieved.



IMPORTANT:



Begin your application with the words:



“PROPERTY INVESTMENT”



This lets us know you read the entire job posting.



We are looking for someone who wants a long-term opportunity and can grow with our real estate investment company.

title: Sales & Executive Administrator / Virtual Assistant
description:

Working Arrangements

• Full-time remote position

title: Local SEO
description:
About the work



We manage digital marketing for a family dental practice in Gilbert, Arizona. The practice has a strong local reputation, over 358 Google reviews at a 4.9 average, and a Google Business Profile that performs well.



The problem is specific. The website ranks at position 1.7 for the practice name and almost nowhere for the services people actually search: dental implants, extractions, fillings, oral surgery. Those keywords generate hundreds of impressions per month at positions 30 to 50 and produce close to zero clicks.



This is a long term role, not a one off project. We want someone who takes ownership of local SEO and citations and keeps improving them month after month.



What you will do



Citations, ongoing (a core part of this role)



Audit and correct existing listings. There are currently at least four incorrect phone numbers and one incorrect suite number published across the web

Build new citations every month on dental, medical, and local directories such as Healthgrades, Zocdoc, Vitals, WebMD, and relevant Arizona and Gilbert directories

Find and resolve duplicate or unclaimed listings

Re check listings on a regular schedule, because directories change data without warning

Keep a running tracker of every listing, its status, and the exact name, address, and phone published on it



On-page SEO in WordPress



Write and set title tags, meta descriptions, and Open Graph tags using Rank Math

Fix missing H1 headings on service and contact pages

Set up 301 redirects for pages that changed URLs

Find and fix broken internal links

Resolve duplicate URL variants (for example /reviews and /reviews/)



Google Business Profile



Optimize categories, services, business description, Q&A, and photos

Deploy and validate LocalBusiness and Dentist schema markup on the website



Reporting



Track keyword position changes in Google Search Console

Report every week on what was completed, what changed, and what you recommend next

What we need from you

2 or more years doing local SEO for US-based businesses

Real citation building and cleanup experience, including handling duplicate listings

Comfortable working inside WordPress with the Elementor page builder

You have used Rank Math or Yoast for real client work, not just tutorials

You can read Google Search Console and Google Business Profile data and explain what it means

Clear written English. You will be reporting your own work, so we need to understand you

You finish things. This matters more to us than anything else on this list

Nice to have

Experience with WP Rocket caching and Cloudflare

Experience with healthcare or dental clients

Basic HTML and CSS for small page edits

Familiarity with the Medicross WordPress theme

About finishing



Our biggest problem with past work has not been skill. It has been tasks that were 80 percent done and called finished.



A page went live but had no title tag. A broken link was fixed on the homepage but no redirect was created, so the old URL still returned a 404. A new page was published but was never added to the site navigation, so nobody could find it.



For us, a task is done when: the change is live, the metadata is set, internal links point to it, redirects exist if a URL changed, and you have verified it yourself in a logged out browser with the cache cleared.



If you check your own work before calling it complete, you will do well here and we will keep you busy long term.



What this is not



This is not a link building or content writing role. We write our own content. We do not want private blog networks, purchased links, bulk directory spam, or AI generated filler pages. We are a real practice with real patients and we are building this properly.

title: Direct Response Video Editor (VSL) - Remote, Part-Time or Full-Time
description:
Most editors never find out if their work sold anything. You cut it, you send it, the client says "love it," and that's the last you ever hear. You've been paid to guess for years.



This job is the opposite.



We're Dogbiotics. We make a dental supplement for dogs that's backed by three peer-reviewed published studies, and we've sold it to more than 40,000 customers. We run real paid spend, every week, and we know exactly which creative is working and which isn't.



We're hiring video editors to cut the ads that carry that spend. You'll see the performance data on every single thing you make. When your cuts win, you get paid more. There's no ceiling on that.



What you'll actually be doing



You'll cut 2-5 minute VSLs and direct response video ads for a 55+ audience of dog owners who are scared of putting their senior dog under anesthesia for a $1,500 dental cleaning. Holding that person's attention for three straight minutes is genuinely hard. That's the job.



You'll also cut variants of your own winners. Most of the work in direct response isn't new ideas every week. It's finding the thing that works and then attacking it from nine angles until it stops working. If iteration bores you, this seat will make you miserable.



Most of what you make will get killed by the data, not by us. That's not a criticism of you. That's how the discipline works, and the editors who thrive here are the ones who find that freeing instead of crushing.



What we need from you



Real direct response experience. Not brand films. Not wedding videos. Ads that ran on paid traffic with a conversion goal.



Long-form. You've cut 2-5 minute VSLs before and you understand why the 40-second mark is where you lose everyone.



Genuine AI fluency. Not "I've used ChatGPT." We mean AI is load-bearing in your actual pipeline: script variants, voice, generative 



b-roll, captioning, assembly. We'll ask you specifically where it sits in your process and what it replaced.



Speed. Quality edits. quickly.



A portfolio. Details below, and please don't send a showreel.

We don't care about your degree. We don't care how many years you've been doing this. If your last three edits are your best three edits, we should talk.



How we work



You see the performance data on your own edits. Spend, hook rate, hold, CPA, and whether it scaled or got turned off. That is standard here, not a perk we hand out on request.



There is a standing weekly creative review where we go through what ran, what the numbers were, and what we are cutting next.



Hours are 100% flexible. Part-time and full-time are both real options, not a trial period before we push you into full-time.



Growth path is editor to senior editor to owning the video lane.



Pay is strong and tied to performance. We handle the specifics on the call.



To apply



One Google Form: 



It takes about 10 minutes. It asks for your portfolio and a few questions about how you work.



No showreels. No agencies.

title: Canva Designer
description:
# Canva Product Designer



I’m looking for a **highly experienced Canva designer** to help me create a large number of designs for **one product**.



This is not a role for someone who only knows the basics of Canva. I need someone who is **very comfortable with Canva, has a strong eye for design, pays attention to small details, and can independently research and make good creative decisions.**



You should also **know how to use Higgsfield** and be comfortable using it as an additional tool to help create and improve designs.



### What you’ll be doing



I will provide you with **templates, examples, instructions, and explain the entire process**, so you will have a clear system to follow.



The work is focused on **one product**, but there is a lot of room to scale the number of designs we create for it.



Your work will include:



* Creating high-quality designs in Canva using the templates I provide

* Creating **many different designs and variations for the same product**

* Using **Higgsfield** when helpful to create visual elements and support the design process

* Using **Pinterest, Google, and ChatGPT specifically for design research and design decisions**

* Researching visual styles, layouts, color combinations, typography, design trends, inspiration, and other relevant design elements

* Comparing different design approaches and d
 which direction will work best

* Finding new design ideas and directions that allow us to keep scaling the number of designs for the product

* Thinking carefully about what will make the designs visually appealing and professional

* Checking your own work and making sure every detail is correct before considering a design finished

* Improving designs based on feedback and learning our system as we work together



**All research you do will be focused on making better design decisions.** You will use Pinterest, Google, and ChatGPT to find inspiration, explore different visual directions, compare ideas, and determine the best design approach.



Higgsfield will also be part of the design process, so I’m looking for someone who understands how to use it effectively alongside Canva.



A complete design can take **around 10 hours when done properly**, depending on the work involved. Quality is much more important to me than simply finishing as quickly as possible.



### Who I’m looking for



You should have **a lot of experience with Canva** and be able to show examples of previous work. Experience using **Higgsfield is also important.**



More importantly, I need someone who can **think independently and take ownership of their work**. I don’t want to explain every tiny design decision. I will teach you the system and show you exactly what we are creating, but I expect you to research, think, compare options, and put real effort into producing the best possible result.



**This is a very important role for me.**



I want someone who will treat this product as if it were **their own product and their own business**. That means caring about quality, doing proper design research, constantly looking for ways to improve the designs, noticing mistakes, and not taking shortcuts.



If you are looking to do the minimum amount of work possible, rush through designs, or simply wait for instructions for every small detail, **please don’t apply. I don’t want to waste your time or mine.**



There is the potential to create **a large volume of designs for this one product**, so I need someone who can maintain a high standard of quality while continuing to come up with strong design directions and variations.



### Payment



We will **discuss and agree on compensation together** based on your experience, skills, working arrangement, and the quality of your work.



### How to apply



Please send:



1. A short introduction about yourself

2. Your experience with Canva

3. Your experience using Higgsfield

4. Examples/portfolio of designs you have created

5. How comfortable you are using **Pinterest, Google, and ChatGPT for design research**

6. Your general availability

7. Why you think you would be a good fit for this role



**Please start your application with the word “CANVA” so I know you read the entire job post.**



I’m looking for someone reliable, detail-oriented, creative, and serious about doing excellent work. If that sounds like you, I’d like to hear from you.

title: Wealth Counsel Drafting Estate Planning Attorney
description:
Remote Estate Planning Attorney / WealthCounsel Document Drafter

Philippines-Based | Remote | 25–30 Hours Per Week With Opportunity to Grow to Full-Time



Compensation: $15–$18USD per hour, depending upon experience; exceptional candidates with significant advanced estate-planning and WealthCounsel experience may be considered at the higher rate.



Who We Are

The Elder Law & Life Care Planning Center is a North Carolina elder law and estate-planning practice with offices in Shallotte and Wilmington, North Carolina.

We do sophisticated estate planning, elder law, asset-protection planning, incapacity planning, and planning for families who want to protect what they have spent a lifetime building.

But that describes what we do. It does not fully explain why we do it.

Our philosophy is A Practice With Purpose.

We believe estate planning is about far more than preparing documents. It is about helping people age with intention, protecting families when illness or incapacity changes their lives, preserving assets from unnecessary loss, protecting vulnerable family members, and helping people make thoughtful decisions before a crisis makes those decisions for them.

We listen before we recommend. We educate before we ask people to d
.

We are serious about the quality of our work and equally serious about how we treat the people who entrust us with their families and their stories.

We are now looking for another attorney who shares that mindset.



Who We Are Looking For

We are looking for a Philippines-based attorney with estate-planning experience to join us remotely, initially for approximately 25–30 hours per week, with the potential for the position to grow into a full-time role.

The primary responsibility will be the drafting and customization of estate-planning documents using WealthCounsel.

Accordingly, actual proficiency with WealthCounsel/WealthDocs data entry and document drafting is strongly preferred.

We are particularly interested in an attorney who has experience with more sophisticated estate-planning concepts and customized trust drafting. However, we are willing to train the right attorney who presently has experience primarily with more basic estate planning if that person demonstrates intellectual curiosity, strong legal reasoning, exceptional attention to detail, and a genuine desire to learn.

We are not looking for someone whose ego requires that he or she already know everything.

We are looking for someone who wants to learn, asks thoughtful questions, cares about getting things right, and takes pride in producing excellent work.



Purpose matters here.



What You Will Be Doing

Your principal responsibility will be translating our attorneys’ planning instructions into accurate, thoughtful and highly customized estate-planning documents.

Your work will include:

• Drafting estate-planning documents through WealthCounsel/WealthDocs, including both irrevocable and revocable living   trusts, wills, durable powers of attorney, health-care documents and related ancillary documents.

• Drafting and assisting with more sophisticated trust and asset-protection planning as your experience and training progress.

• Carefully entering and reviewing client and planning information within WealthCounsel.

• Customizing WealthCounsel provisions to reflect the actual planning decisions made for a particular family rather than simply accepting default provisions.

• Reviewing generated documents critically rather than assuming that software-generated language is automatically correct.

• Incorporating attorney-drafted customized library provisions into WealthCounsel-generated documents.

• Proofreading complete estate-planning packages for names, relationships, fiduciaries, succession provisions, distributions, cross-references, defined terms, formatting and internal consistency.

• Identifying inconsistencies, missing information and potential drafting issues and bringing them to the attorney’s attention.

• Comparing planning instructions against the completed documents before submitting a package for attorney review.

• Maintaining organized drafting notes and following our established drafting and quality-control standard operating procedures.

• Participating in regular training, document-review and strategization meetings with our attorney and staff.



Customization Is Important to Us



WealthCounsel is an extraordinarily useful drafting platform, but we do not believe good estate planning consists of simply answering an interview and printing the resulting documents.



Every family is different.



Our documents frequently contain customized provisions designed around a client’s family dynamics, incapacity concerns, asset-protection objectives, beneficiary circumstances and long-term planning goals.

That means we need a drafter who can eventually understand not merely what language to insert, but why we are inserting it.

We want you to develop that understanding.

The successful candidate will learn our drafting philosophy, our preferred provisions and the reasoning behind them. Over time, we want this person to become someone with whom we can discuss a planning problem—not merely someone to whom we send data for entry.



Accuracy Is Non-Negotiable



Estate-planning documents govern people’s assets, families, health-care decisions and legacies. Small errors can have significant consequences.



We therefore need someone who naturally notices details.

You should be the person who sees that:

• a name is spelled differently on page 42 than it is on page 3;

• a successor fiduciary appears in the wrong order;

• a pronoun is incorrect;

• a defined term is used inconsistently;

• a distribution provision does not match the planning instructions;

• a cross-reference points to the wrong section;

• a customized provision conflicts with another provision elsewhere in the document; or

• something simply does not make sense and needs to be questioned before the document leaves your desk.



We value accuracy over speed, although with experience we expect both.



Qualifications

Required or strongly preferred:

• Attorney or lawyer based in the Philippines, preferably admitted to practice and in good standing.

• Excellent communication skills

• Estate-planning experience.

• Experience drafting trusts, wills, powers of attorney and related estate-planning documents.

• Working proficiency with WealthCounsel/WealthDocs strongly preferred.

• Excellent written English and a strong command of American English grammar and legal terminology.

• Exceptional proofreading and attention-to-detail skills.

• Ability to understand and follow detailed written and verbal instructions.

• Strong organizational and time-management skills.

• Ability to manage multiple drafting projects and deadlines.

• Excellent judgment about when to proceed independently and when to stop and ask a question.

• Comfortable receiving detailed attorney feedback and incorporating that feedback into future work.

• Strong computer skills, including Microsoft Word.

• Reliable high-speed internet and a professional remote working environment.

• Absolute respect for client confidentiality and data security.



Particularly Valuable Experience

We would be especially interested in candidates who have experience with any of the following:

• Advanced U.S. estate planning;

• Revocable and irrevocable trusts;

• Asset-protection planning;

• Elder-law planning;

• Medicaid-related estate-planning concepts;

• Special needs or beneficiary-protection trusts;

• Customized distribution provisions;

• Trust administration;

• Tax-sensitive estate-planning concepts;

• Drafting for high-net-worth or complex families;

• Supporting U.S.-based estate-planning attorneys; or

• Developing or maintaining customized WealthCounsel provisions.



You do not need to have experience in every one of these areas.

We are willing to teach sophisticated planning to an attorney who brings the right foundation, intellectual curiosity and work ethic.



The Person Matters as Much as the Resume



We are deliberately looking for someone who is purpose-driven rather than ego-driven.

You will probably thrive here if you:

• genuinely enjoy learning;

• care whether your work is correct;

• ask questions when something does not make sense;

• can receive constructive criticism without becoming defensive;

• take ownership of mistakes and learn from them;

• do not make the same mistake repeatedly;

• understand that careful legal drafting requires judgment, not merely data entry;

• are dependable and follow through on commitments;

• enjoy becoming exceptionally good at something;

• understand that sophisticated work is learned over time;

• care about the people ultimately affected by the documents you prepare; and

• want to become an important part of a small, highly committed professional team.



We do not expect perfection on Day One.

We do expect honesty, effort, curiosity, accountability and continual improvement.



Schedule and Working Relationship

This is a remote position based in the Philippines for approximately 25–30 hours per week initially, with the possibility of growing into a full-time position as the relationship and workload develop.

Much of the drafting work may be completed independently. However, this is not intended to be an anonymous outsourcing relationship.

Working together matters to us.

We expect regular video meetings for training, review of drafts, discussion of customized provisions and development of the attorney’s understanding of our planning philosophy.



Because of the time difference, meetings will generally be scheduled during the early morning in U.S. Eastern Time (ET), which corresponds to evening hours in the Philippines.

For example, depending upon U.S. daylight-saving time:

7:00–9:00 a.m. Eastern Time will generally correspond to approximately 7:00–10:00 p.m. Philippine Time.



To start, Saturday or Sunday availability is necessary for training or substantive document-review meetings. We will endeavor to schedule these meetings in advance and respectfully.  While weekend meetings may continue given the schedule of the attorney, we will try to focus on Mondays and Fridays as often as we are able.



Compensation

We anticipate compensation in the range of:

$15–$18 USD per hour, depending upon experience and demonstrated proficiency.



An exceptional candidate who already possesses substantial WealthCounsel proficiency and sophisticated U.S. estate-planning drafting experience may be considered at a higher rate.

Our objective is not to find the least expensive person who can produce documents.

Our objective is to find the right attorney, invest in that person’s development, and build a long-term working relationship.

How to Apply

Please submit:

1. Your resume or CV.

2. A short introduction telling us about your estate-planning experience.

3. A description of your actual experience using WealthCounsel/WealthDocs, including approximately how long you have used it and the types of documents you have drafted.

Tell us about a time when you found something in a legal document that did not look right—even though no one had specifically asked you to look for it. What did you notice, and what did you do?

If you are looking for a remote legal position where you can deepen your estate-planning knowledge, become a more sophisticated drafter, and work with people who believe the practice of law should have purpose and a mission behind it, we would like to hear from you.



Elder Law & Life Care Planning Center

A Practice With Purpose

title: INBOUND APPOINTMENT SETTER — HAIR SALON (WARM FACEBOOK/INSTAGRAM LEADS, $1,250–$2,000/MO OTE + 13TH MONTH PAY)
description:
READ THIS FIRST



We're hiring ONE full-time Inbound Appointment Setter to call warm leads from our
 and Instagram ad campaigns for a color-specialist hair salon in Fontana, California.



This is NOT cold calling. Every lead you speak to has already raised their hand by submitting their info through one of our ads. Your job is to reach them fast, build trust quickly, understand what they actually want, and guide them into a booked appointment.



This role demands two things at once: sharp conversational judgment AND tight process discipline. The conversations are where you win or lose the booking. The process — cadences, call dispositions, CRM hygiene, follow-up tasks — is what makes the whole system work and what lets us measure anything. You need both. People who are great at one and sloppy at the other don't last here.



On the conversation side, what we're really hiring for is the ability to think on your feet. Someone replies three days later with just "sorry, been busy." Someone says they want highlights but describes something else entirely. Someone says "that's a bit far for me" but what they really mean is they don't see why it's worth the drive. If you can read what people actually mean and move the conversation forward without being told what to say next, you'll do well here.



If you need to be spoon-fed a script for every situation, this won't work.



THIS IS A SALES ROLE. YOU NEED AT LEAST 6 MONTHS OF EXPERIENCE

PERSUADING PEOPLE AND MOVING THEM TOWARD A BOOKED APPOINTMENT

OR A SALE.



OTE: $1,250–$2,000/month (base $900–$1,000 + uncapped performance bonuses).

13th month pay included — paid every December, on top of your base. Not baked in. Not restructured. A full extra month of base pay, added on top.



---



ABOUT THE COMPANY



You'll be employed by Midnight Siren, a growth and client acquisition company that operates and supports beauty service businesses. Your day-to-day work focuses on a family-owned, color-specialist hair salon in Fontana, California that has served the Inland Empire for over 21 years.



The salon has 4.9 stars on Google with 200+ reviews and a stylist team with 75+ combined years of experience. The business is real, established, and respected in its market.



You'll work directly under Ethan, the founder of Midnight Siren — no middle managers, no agency layers between you and the person making decisions. The Midnight Siren team is small and tightly focused. The stylists at salon handle the in-salon experience; you and Ethan handle everything that gets a client booked.



A note on team structure: you will be the only appointment setter on the team. Your day-to-day working relationship is directly with Ethan. There are no peer-level coworkers, no team chat with other appointment setters, no group energy to feed off. If you thrive with autonomy, clear systems, and a direct manager relationship, this works well. If you need a team environment or peer social dynamic to stay motivated, this will feel isolating over time.



We're in an active scaling phase. Core processes exist and are being refined. They don't change daily, but they evolve as we learn. If you like improving systems alongside a team, you'll fit. If you want a fully crystallized corporate environment where nothing ever shifts, you won't.



---



WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY BE DOING



This is a front-line revenue role, not customer support.



Daily:



- Call new
/Instagram ad leads within minutes of opt-in (speed matters — you'll have task notifications throughout the day)

- Run our call script for the structured parts of the call, and use our frameworks + your own judgment for discovery and objection handling. The script covers the greeting, the offer, pricing, and the booking ask. Discovery can't be fully scripted — clients say what they say, and you'll need to adapt in real time.

- Respond to inbound SMS,
 
, and Instagram DMs that get escalated to a human when our AI can't handle them

- Collect cards on file via secure link (never over the phone), book appointments, reschedule, and cancel

- Call no-shows to get them back on the calendar

- Coordinate with stylists about client requests and scheduling needs

- Create follow-up tasks in HighLevel (our CRM)

- Submit a brief end-of-day report with your numbers



Weekly:



- One coaching/review call with Ethan (~30–45 min)

- Async coaching via Loom video reviews on your live call recordings between meetings

- Review your KPIs, own your numbers, and bring data-backed ideas to improve them



During training (first 2–4 weeks):



We'll meet daily for live coaching to get you fully ramped before transitioning to the weekly + async cadence.



---



A WORD ON THE CALL SCRIPT (READ CAREFULLY)



We use a script. We also need you to think.



Where the script is fixed: the greeting, how we introduce the salon, how we present the offer, how we state pricing, the booking ask, and our core objection responses. These are tested and they work. You run them as written. Your tone, warmth, and pacing are what make them sound human — not changing the words.



Where the script can't help you: everything a real client throws at you. A vague text with no context. A client describing a service using the wrong name. Someone who's hesitant but won't say why. Someone who asks about price before you've figured out what they actually want. There is no script for these. There's a framework, and there's your judgment.



This is the part people underestimate. A big chunk of this job is not reciting — it's listening to what someone actually means and figuring out the next move in seconds, while they're on the phone with you.



Scripts do change here, but only based on data. If you bring an idea for a better line, we'll A/B test it. If it wins, it becomes the script. What we don't do is let setters freelance changes on the fly, because then we can't measure what works.



If you want to be told exactly what to say in every situation, this role will frustrate you. If you like having strong structure AND room to think, you'll do well.



---



SCHEDULE (PACIFIC TIME — GRAVEYARD SHIFT IN PHILIPPINES)



All schedule references in this post are in US Pacific Time. Because PH is 15-16 hours ahead of California, each shift starts late at night your time and ends the following morning.

- US workdays: Monday through Friday

- US days off: Saturday and Sunday

- Hours per day: 8 hours of work + 1 hour of break (30 min lunch + 2× 15 min breaks, or 30 min lunch + 1× 30 min break — your call)

- Pacific Time (US): 7:45 AM – 4:45 PM PST



Philippine Time during US Standard Time (roughly November through mid-March):



Shift runs 11:45 PM – 8:45 AM PHT

- A US Monday shift = late Monday night through Tuesday morning your time

- A US Friday shift = late Friday night through Saturday morning your time

- Your days off in PH local time: Sunday and Monday (until your shift starts late Monday night)



Philippine Time during US Daylight Savings Time (roughly mid-March through early November):



- Shift runs 10:45 PM – 7:45 AM PHT

- Same day-shift logic as above — shift starts the previous calendar evening in PH



This schedule is FIXED. It's based on data showing when our booking demand peaks. If you need flexible hours, rotating shifts, or plan to hold another job during these times, this role is not a fit.

Please re-read this section carefully and make sure BOTH the standard-time and daylight-savings schedules work for you long-term before applying. The 1-hour shift twice a year is non-negotiable — it follows US business hours. Please make sure BOTH schedules work for you long-term before applying.



---



COMPENSATION



Base pay:



$900–$1,000/month (depending on experience), paid via Wise on the 1st and 15th of every month.



13TH MONTH PAY included — paid every December on top of your regular base, not restructured into it. Prorated in your first year if you start mid-year. Total annualized base compensation including 13th month: $11,700–$13,000.



Performance bonuses (uncapped, paid monthly):



- $3 per new client showed appointment

- $2 per existing client showed appointment

- $1 per rebooking confirmation (low-effort confirmation calls for clients who already booked through the salon)



Tiered cumulative threshold bonuses (paid monthly):



- +$75 at 90 showed appointments/month

- +$150 at 120 showed appointments/month

- +$350 at 150 showed appointments/month



Worked examples:



Baseline performer — 90 showed appointments/month:

- Base: $950 (midpoint)

- Performance: ~$225 (avg $2.50/show × 90)

- Threshold bonus: $75

- Total: ~$1,250/month



Solid performer — 120 showed appointments/month:

- Base: $950

- Performance: ~$300 (avg $2.50/show × 120)

- Threshold bonus: $225 ($75 + $150)

- Total: ~$1,475/month



Top performer — 150 showed appointments/month (90% show rate on ~167 booked):

- Base: $1,000

- Performance: $450 ($3×90 new + $2×20 existing + $1×40 rebooking)

- Threshold bonuses: $575 ($75 + $150 + $350)

- Total: ~$2,025/month



This is a PERFORMANCE-PAY ROLE. 30–50% of your monthly income should be earned through bonuses. The base is intentionally modest. If you want a high guaranteed salary with low expectations, this is not the role.



---



OTHER BENEFITS



1. Annual performance-based raise after your first year

2. 14 days of PTO per year, single bucket, available after 90-day probation (use for vacation, holidays, sickness — your call). For planned multi-day time off, give us at least 1 week's notice so we can plan coverage. Emergencies are understood — just communicate as soon as you can.

3. 90-day initial probation period. Pay is NOT REDUCED during probation.



To confirm you have read this post in full, include the word BURGUNDY in your answer to the final question on the application form



---



TARGET KPIs



- Lead to Booking Rate: 25%+

- Show Rate: 90%+

- Bookings per day: 4–9

- Showed appointments per month: 100–160

- Daily volume: Finish all assigned tasks each day. We supply ~17–25 leads per day plus follow-ups, no-shows, reactivations, and rebooking confirmations. HIGH CALL VOLUME (150–250 CALLS/DAY) IS NORMAL AND NON-NEGOTIABLE. If that sounds overwhelming instead of energizing, this is not a fit.



---



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



Background:



- Female candidates tend to perform best with our 35–65 female clientele, so we especially encourage strong female applicants — but the role is open to all genders.

- Bilingual (English + Spanish) is a plus but not required.



Non-negotiable skills:



The five that matter most — these are what we screen hardest for:



- Real-time thinking. You generate a good response in seconds, not minutes. Under pressure, with no script in front of you. This is the single biggest predictor of success in this role.

- Inferential listening. You hear what someone means, not just what they said. A client says "I need to talk to my husband first" — she's usually not asking for permission, she's telling you something about price or certainty that she doesn't want to say directly. If you take everything at face value, you'll lose bookings.

- Conversational initiative. You never dead-end a conversation, and you don't give up on a lead that's still alive. A client says "that's kind of far for me" — a weak setter says "no problem, thanks anyway" and loses her. What she's actually telling you is that she doesn't believe the drive is worth it yet. That's not a rejection, it's an assumption you haven't disproven. Answering someone's question is only half a response; the other half is the move that keeps things going.

- Rapport building. You can get someone to open up and feel comfortable with you fast. This is the biggest factor in whether someone books. These are emotional decisions, not logical ones. You don't need American cultural references — you need to make people feel heard, understood, and safe.

- Diagnostic reframing. You can say someone's problem back to them more clearly than they said it. When you do that, people assume you have the solution. It's the fastest way to build trust that exists.



Everything else:



- ADVANCED ENGLISH WITH MINIMAL ACCENT. An American listener should not need to strain to understand you. If we have to focus to follow what you're saying, that's a disqualifier.

- STRONG SPOKEN COMMUNICATION — CLEAR, CONFIDENT VOICE. YOU DO NOT RAMBLE. YOU ARE NOT SOFT-SPOKEN. If you fill silence with words because dead air makes you nervous, this won't work.

- Typing speed: 40 wpm minimum (60+ strongly preferred). You'll be taking notes and sending texts while talking. You'll submit a typing test screenshot with your application.

- Process discipline. Every call gets dispositioned correctly. Every lead moves through the right cadence. Every opportunity gets marked accurately in the CRM. This isn't optional admin — it's how we measure everything. Great conversations with sloppy process still means we're flying blind.

- Script discipline for the structured parts of the call.

- Natural call control. You can guide a conversation efficiently without talking over clients or letting calls drift. You redirect politely and keep the call outcome-focused.

- Sales experience: 6 months minimum (1 year+ preferred). Job-hopping resumes (multiple roles under 3–6 months each) will be disqualified.

- Comfortable holding the line on policies (rescheduling, deposits, etc.) without weakening the script or over-promising.

- Objection handling — you acknowledge, ask questions to reframe, and guide the client. You don't fire off rebuttals that invoke more resistance.

- CRM literacy. GoHighLevel experience strongly preferred.

- High data accuracy. You enter info correctly the first time. This is a precision role, not a speed-only one.

- Strong working memory and multitasking — you can listen, think, type, recall rules, and follow scripts simultaneously without freezing.

- Emotional steadiness under high-volume periods. Spikes happen. You execute calm under load.



Preferred:



- Familiarity with the salon/beauty industry

- Personal interest in beauty or self-care

- Experience working with older female clientele (35–65)

- Experience with Slack, Slite, Airtable, Claude or ChatGPT (we use AI to streamline daily work — if you can leverage it, you'll move faster)



Mindset (MOST IMPORTANT):



We'd rather hire someone who's a 10 in mindset and 7 in sales skill than the reverse. Here's what we mean:



- Ownership & volume mindset — you take responsibility for outcomes, not tasks. You see high-volume, repetitive work as leverage, not burnout.

- Process discipline — you operate consistently inside defined systems. You let your personality show through tone and warmth, not by changing the words.

- Sales psychology — you understand how to influence through trust, value framing, and subtle urgency. You communicate with intention, not chit-chat.

- Speed bias — you move fast, close loops quickly, and accelerate under pressure instead of slowing down.

- Coachability — you receive feedback without ego and adapt immediately. No defensiveness, no excuses.

- KPI awareness — you understand the numbers behind your role and how your daily actions move them.



---



TECH REQUIREMENTS



Non-negotiable:



- Internet minimum requirements: 50 Mbps download, 10 Mbps upload, ping under 80ms. Stable connection. We will test your speed and audio live from your actual work setup before we hire.

- Backup plan for outages. If your internet or power cuts out mid-shift, you need a real fallback — mobile hotspot, secondary ISP, UPS, co-working space, or some combination. You'll describe your specific backup setup in your application.

- Computer: 8 GB RAM minimum (16+ preferred). Processor: Intel Core i5 or equivalent, 8th generation or newer. SSD preferred. Working laptop or desktop

- Mouse

- Wired headset with boom mic (3.5mm or USB-C). No Bluetooth, no laptop mic, no AirPods.

- Webcam — laptop built-in is fine. You'll be on camera for interviews, training, and coaching calls.

- Quiet, dedicated workspace. No roosters, no karaoke neighbors, no babies crying, no traffic, no dogs barking during calls. We will hear it on the call, and so will our clients.



Preferred:



- Second monitor

- You already own a headset that meets the requirements above (we'll provide one if you don't, but having your own helps you start faster)



---



DO NOT APPLY IF:



- You struggle to think quickly and respond in real time. If you need a moment to figure out what to say, this role will be painful. Clients don't wait.

- You need the client to lead the conversation. If you're comfortable answering questions but not steering, this isn't it.

- You can't hold a conversation without a script telling you what to say next.

- You type slowly. Under 40 wpm means you'll fall behind on notes and texts while you're talking.

- You have less than 6 months of experience persuading people, handling objections, and closing toward a booked appointment or sale.

- Your spoken English is hard to understand on the phone — this is a phone role first and the single biggest dealbreaker

- You're juggling multiple clients or planning to freelance on the side. THIS MUST BE YOUR ONLY JOB. We track performance closely and will discover this fast.

- You want a high guaranteed salary with low performance pressure

- You don't like high call volume or you find scripts "suffocating"

- You see remote work as "work whenever you feel like it"

- You can't sustain a graveyard shift long-term

- You're looking for a short-term gig — we expect a minimum 12-month commitment after probation



---



HIRING PROCESS



1. Application via Tally form (link below) — includes voice recording, Loom video, internet speed screenshot, backup plan description, and a few short written questions

2. 20-minute pre-screen call with our hiring partner

3. First-round interview with Ethan (~45 min) — includes live roleplay

4. Second-round interview with Ethan (~45 min) — final fit + offer discussion

5. Offer — targeting hires between August 10 – August 20

6. Paid training begins immediately after offer acceptance



---



HOW TO APPLY



Submit your application through this Tally form: |

IMPORTANT: There is a confirmation requirement embedded in this post. Applications that miss it will be skipped regardless of experience.



The form will ask for:

- A description of your backup plan for power/internet outages

Applications submitted via direct messages on OnlineJobs.ph will NOT be reviewed. Use the Tally form.

Looking forward to meeting the right person.



Ethan

Founder, Midnight Siren
